senior_secondary.questionText:
拋物線 \Gamma 的方程為 y=2x^2-2kx+2x-3k+8  ,其中 k 為一實常數。 將直線 y=19 記為 L  。
(a) 證明 L 與 \Gamma 相交於兩相異點 。
(b)  L 與 \Gamma 的交點為 A 及 B  。
(i) 設 a 及 b 分別為 A 及 B 的 x 坐標。 證明 (a-b)^2=k^2+4k+23  。
(ii)  A 與 B 間的距離有沒有可能少於 4? 試解釋你的答案 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The equation of the parabola \Gamma is y = 2x^2 - 2kx + 2x - 3k + 8, where k is a real constant. Let the line y = 19 be L.

(a) Prove that L intersects \Gamma at two non-intersecting points.

(b) The intersection points of L and \Gamma are A and B.

(i) Let a and b be the x coordinates of A and B, respectively. Prove that (a-b)^2 = k^2 + 4k + 23.

(ii) Is it possible that the distance between A and B is less than 4? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
  \begin{cases}y=19\\y=2x^2-2kx+2x-3k+8\end{cases}  

 19=2x^{2}-2kx+2x-3k+8 

 2x^{2}-2kx+2x-3k-11=0 

 \begin{array}{c}{\Delta}\\{=(-2k+2)^{2}-4(2)(-3k-11)}\\\end{array} 

 =4k^{2}+16k+92 

 =4(k+2)^{2}+76 

 \geq76  , for all real values of  k 
 \therefore\Delta>0  , for all real values of  k 
 L  and  \Gamma  intersect at two distinct points.

bi)
\begin{aligned}
    a,b\text{ are the roots of }2x^2-2kx+2x-3k-11=0 \\
    \mathrm{ab} \\
    =\frac{-3k-11}{2} \\
    =-\frac{3k+11}{2} \\
    a+b \\
    =-\frac{-2k+2}{2} \\
    =k-1 \\
    (a-b)^{2} \\
    =a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab \\
    =\left(a+b\right)^{2}-4ab \\
    =(k-1)^{2}-4(-\frac{3k+11}{2}) \\
    =k^{2}-2k+1+6k+22 \\
    =k^{2}+4k+23
\end{aligned}

bii)
  \begin{aligned}  AB\\  =\sqrt{(a-b)^2}\\  =\sqrt{k^2+4k+23}\\  =\sqrt{(k+2)^2+19}\\  \geq\sqrt{19}=4.358898944,\text{for all real values of } k\\  \text{No, it is impossible.}\end{aligned}
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
"18a)

\begin{cases}y=19\\y=2x^2-2kx+2x-3k+8\end{cases}

19=2x^{2}-2kx+2x-3k+8

2x^{2}-2kx+2x-3k-11=0

\begin{array}{c}{\Delta}\\{=(-2k+2)^{2}-4(2)(-3k-11)}\\\end{array}

=4k^{2}+16k+92

=4(k+2)^{2}+76

\geq76，對所有實數 k

\therefore\Delta>0，對所有實數 k

L 和 \Gamma 相交於兩個不同的點分數。

18bi)

\begin{aligned}

 a,b\text{ 是方程式 }2x^2-2kx+2x-3k-11=0 的根 \\

 \mathrm{ab} \\

 =\frac{-3k-11}{2} \\

 =-\frac{3k+11}{2} \\

 a+b \\

 =-\frac{-2k+2}{2} \\

 =k-1 \\

 (a-b)^{2} \\

 =a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab \\

 =\left(a+b\right)^{2}-4ab \\

 =(k-1)^{2}-4(-\frac{3k+11}{2}) \\

 =k^{2}-2k+1+6k+22 \\

 =k^{2}+4k+23

\end{aligned}

18bii)

\begin{aligned}AB\\=\sqrt{(a-b)^2}\\=\sqrt{k^2+4k+23}\\=\sqrt{(k+2)^2+19}\\\geq\sqrt{19}=4.35898894. }\end{aligned}"

設 p(x)=4x^2+12x+c  ,其中 c 為一常數 。方程 p(x)=0 有等根 。 求
( a)  c  ,
(b)  y= p (x)-169 的圖像的 x 截距 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Let p(x) = 4x^2 + 12x + c, where c is a constant. The equation p(x) = 0 has equal roots. Find the x intercepts of the graphs of

(a) c,

(b) y = p(x) - 169.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
7a)
由於方程  4x^2+12x+c=0  有等根，可得  \Delta=0  。
  \begin{aligned}
   12^2-4(4)c=0 \\
   144-16c=0 \\
   c=9
\end{aligned}  

7b)
 y 

 =p(x)-169 

 =4x^{2}+12x-160  (藉(a))

 =4(x+8)(x-5) 

因此， y=p(x)-169  的圖像的 x 截距為 -8 及 5 。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
"7a) Since the equation 4x^2+12x+c=0 has equal roots, we can obtain \Delta=0.

\begin{aligned}

 12^2-4(4)c=0 \\

 144-16c=0 \\

 c=9

\end{aligned}

7b)

y

=p(x)-169

=4x^{2}+12x-160 (borrowing(a))

=4(x+8)(x-5)

Therefore, the x-intercept of the graph of y=p(x)-169 is -8 and 5."

senior_secondary.questionText:
某工廠經理估計該廠2000年的收入會由一月份的  500000，每月下跌 r \% 至十二月份的  284400。

(a) 求 r ，答案須準確至最接近的整數。 （3分）

(b) 設該廠2000年一月份的生產成本是  400000 。 該經理建議成本每月遞減  20000 （即二月份的成本為  380000 ，三月份的成本 360000 ，如此類推），並聲稱此舉不會影響該廠的每月收入。

(i) 利用 (a) 中所得的 r 值，證明該廠全年仍有盈利。

(ii) 該廠於 2000 年初會開始一項研究以改善生產方法。該研究的運作成本每月  300000 。 若每 k 個月內花費在研究上的總運作成本超過通年除月份的總生產成本，便會在第 k 個月的結束時停止該項研究。

證明 k^2 - 7lk + 348 < 0 。

由此推斷該項研究會維持多久。（8分）
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
A factory manager estimates that the factory's revenue in 2000 will decrease by r\\% each month from 500,000 in January to 284,400 in December.

(a) Find r, accurate to the nearest integer. (3 points)

(b) Suppose the factory's production cost in January 2000 is 400,000. The manager suggests reducing costs by 20,000 each month (i.e., costs of 380,000 in February, 360,000 in March, and so on), claiming this will not affect the factory's monthly revenue.

(i) Using the value of r obtained in (a), prove that the factory will still be profitable for the year.

(ii) The factory will begin a study at the beginning of 2000 to improve its production methods. The study's operating cost is 300,000 per month. If the total operating cost of the study in each k months exceeds the total annual production cost excluding the months, a problem will occur on the k-th month. The study will cease at the end of the month.

Prove that k^2 - 7lk + 348 < 0.

From this, infer how long the study will continue. (8 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
17a)
\begin{aligned}
    500000(1-r  \%)^{11}=284400 \\
    1-r  \%=\sqrt[11]{\frac{284400}{500000}}\approx0.95 \\
    r\approx5
\end{aligned}

17bi)
Income for the whole year
=
  (S) {500000(1-0.95^{12}) \over 1-0.95}  
  
\approx (S) 4596399  
Production cost for the whole year
=
  (S) {12 \over 2} (2 \times 400000 - 20000 \times 11)  
  
=(S) 3480000  
  \therefore \text{Income} > \text{Production cost}  
  
\therefore \text{The factory will still make a profit for the whole year.}  

17bii)
Let the research be stopped at the end of the k-th month.
  300000k > 3480000 - \frac{k}{2}[2 \times 400000 - 20000(k - 1)]  
  
30k > 348 - 40k + k(k - 1)  
  k^2 - 71k + 348 < 0  
  
\frac{71 - \sqrt{71^2 - 4 \times 348}}{2} < k < \frac{71 + \sqrt{71^2 - 4 \times 348}}{2}  
  5.2965 < k < 65.7035  
 \therefore  The research project will last for 6 months.

senior_secondary.questionText:
直線y=k(k>0)與曲線y=x^2-3x-4相交於A( \alpha,k )及B( \beta,k )。

(a)(i) 求 \alpha+\beta 的值。
(ii) 以k表 \alpha\beta 。

(b) 若直線AB與y軸相交於P·且BP=2PA·求k的值。（6分）
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The line y = k (k > 0) intersects the curve y = x² - 3x - 4 at points A(\alpha, k) and B(\beta, k).

(a)(i) Find the value of \alpha + \beta.

(ii) Express \alpha and \beta in terms of k.

(b) If the line AB intersects the y-axis at point P and BP = 2PA, find the value of k. (6 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
"8a)

\begin{aligned}

 x^{2}-3x-4=k \\

 x^{2}-3x-k-4=0 \\

 \therefore(\mathrm{i})\quad\alpha+\beta=3 \\

 (\mathrm{ii})\quad\alpha\beta=-k-4

\end{aligned}

8b)

根據分節公式，\frac{2\alpha+\beta}{3}=0

2\alpha+\beta=0。

解方程組 \left\{\begin{array}{l}2\alpha+\beta=3 \\ 2\alpha+\beta=0\end{array}\right.，我們得到

\alpha=-3（或\貝塔=6)

k=(-3)^{2}-2(-3)-4

=14"
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
8a)
\begin{aligned}
    x^{2}-3x-4=k \\
    x^{2}-3x-k-4=0 \\
    \therefore(\mathrm{i})\quad\alpha+\beta=3 \\
    (\mathrm{ii})\quad\alpha\beta=-k-4
\end{aligned}

8b)
By section formula,  \frac{2\alpha+\beta}{3}=0 

 2\alpha+\beta=0 .

Solving  \left\{\begin{array}{l}2\alpha+\beta=3 \\ 2\alpha+\beta=0\end{array}\right. , we have

 \alpha=-3  (or  \beta=6 )

 k=(-3)^{2}-2(-3)-4 

 =14

senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Find a quadratic equation whose roots are $2 + 3t$ and $2 - 3t$ where $i = \sqrt{-1}$.

Express your answer in the form $x^{2} + bx + c = 0$ where $b$ and $c$ are real numbers.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
根和 = 4 根之積 = (2+3i)(2-3i)

= 13
求方程式為 x^2 - 4x + 13 = 0

或者，

\left[ x-(2+3i) \right] \left[ x-(2-3i) \right] = 0
x^2 - 4x + 13 = 0
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Sum of roots = 4  
Product of roots = $(2+3i)(2-3i)$  
= 13  
The required equation is $x^2 - 4x + 13 = 0$  
ALTERNATIVELY,  
$\left[ x-(2+3i) \right] \left[ x-(2-3i) \right] = 0$  
$x^2 - 4x + 13 = 0$

senior_secondary.questionTextEn:

(ii) Area of ​​the enclosed boundary.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
(a) 照片的面積 = \(\alpha \beta = 250\)

(b) (i) 照片的周界 = \(2(\alpha + \beta) = m\)

(ii) 圍邊的面積 = \((\alpha + 4)(\beta + 4) - \alpha \beta = m + 16\)

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
第 1 個圖案包含 3 粒點子。對任意正整數 \( n \)，第 \((n+1)\) 個圖案是由第 \( n \) 個圖案加上 2 粒點子所組成。求 \( m \) 的最小值使得首 \( m \) 個圖案的點子總數超過 \( 6888 \)。  
(4 分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
In Figure 5, the first pattern contains 3 dots. For any positive integer \(n\), the \((n+1)\)th pattern is composed of the \(n\)th pattern plus 2 dots. Find the minimum value of \(m\) such that the total number of dots in the first \(m\) pattern exceeds 688\8\8.

(4 points)"
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
請注意，這些圖案中的點數構成一個等差數列。

前 m 個圖案中的點數總數

= 3 + 5 + 7 + ⋯ + (2m + 1)

= \frac{m}{2}(3 + (2m + 1))

= m^2 + 2m

m^2 + 2m > 6888

m^2 + 2m - 6888 > 0

(m - 82)(m + 84) > 0

m < -84 \text{ 或 } m > 82

因此，m 的最小值為 83。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Note that the numbers of dots in the patterns form an arithmetic sequence.

The total number of dots in the first m patterns
= 3 + 5 + 7 + ⋯ + (2m + 1)
= $\frac{m}{2}(3 + (2m + 1))$
= $m^2 + 2m$

$m^2 + 2m > 6888$
$m^2 + 2m - 6888 > 0$
$(m - 82)(m + 84) > 0$

$m < -84 \text{ or } m > 82$

Thus, the least value of m is 83.

17a) Let d be the common difference of the sequence.

555 = 666 + (38 - 1)d

17b)

1335n - 3n^{2}>0

n(n-445)<0

Therefore, the maximum value of n is 444.

a)
Let  a  and  r  be the first term and the common ratio of the sequence respectively.
  \begin{cases} ar^2 = 720 \\ ar^3 = 864 \end{cases}

b)

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
設 \alpha 及 \beta 均為實數使得 \begin{cases}\beta=5\alpha-18\\\beta=\alpha^{2}-13\alpha\end{cases} 
(a) 求 \alpha  及 \beta 。
(b) 某等差數列的第 1 項及第 2 項分別為 \log\alpha 及 \log\beta  。 求 n 的最小值使得
該數列的首 n 項之和大於 888 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Let \alpha and \beta be real numbers such that \beta = 5\alpha - 18 \mathbb{\alpha^2} - 13\alpha\end{cases}

(a) Find \alpha and \beta.

(b) The first and second terms of an arithmetic sequence are \log\alpha and \log\beta, respectively. Find the minimum value of n such that

the sum of the first n terms of the sequence is greater than 888.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
16a)
\begin{aligned}
    \text{把}\quad\beta=5\alpha-18\quad\text{代人}\quad\beta=\alpha^{2}-13\alpha+63\quad,\quad\text{可得} \\
    5\alpha-18=\alpha^{2}-13\alpha+63 \\
    \alpha^{2}-18\alpha+81=0 \\
    \text{求解後,可得}\quad\alpha=9\quad\text{及}\quad\beta=27\quad\circ
\end{aligned}

16b)
設 T(n) 為該等差數列的第 n 項。
由於 T(1) = log9 = log3^2 = 2log3 及 T(2) = log27 = log3^3 = 3log3，
所以該數列的公差為 log3。
T(1) + T(2) + T(3) + … + T(n) > 888
2log3 + 3log3 + 4log3 + … + (n + 1)log3 > 888
  \frac{n}{2}(2(2log3) + (n - 1)log3) > 888  

(log3)n^2 + (3log3)n - 1776 > 0

n < -62.52928981 或 n > 59.52928981

因此，n 的最小值為 60。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
16a)

\begin{aligned}

 \text{Substituting }\quad\beta=5\alpha-18\quad\text{into }\quad\beta=\alpha^{2}-13\alpha+63\quad,\quad\text{we get} \\

 5\alpha-18=\alpha^{2}-13\alpha+63 \\

 \alpha^{2}-18\alpha+81=0 \\

 \text{After solving, we get }\quad\alpha=9\quad\text{and }\quad\beta=27\quad\circ

\end{aligned}

16b)

Let T(n) be the nth term of the arithmetic sequence.

Since T(1) = log9 = log3^2 = 2log3 and T(2) = log27 = log3^3 = 3log3,

the common difference of the sequence is log3.

T(1) + T(2) + T(3) + … + T(n) > 888

2log3 + 3log3 + 4log3 + … + (n + 1)log3 > 888

\frac{n}{2}(2(2log3) + (n - 1)log3) > 888

(log3)n^2 + (3log3)n - 1776 > 0

n < -62.52928981 or n > 59.52928981

Therefore, the minimum value of n is 60.

1.5^{n}>6.25\times10^{16}+1

n\log 1.5>\log(6.25\times10^{16}+1)

n>95.38167941

senior_secondary.questionText:
假定   \alpha, \beta   為一等比數列，其中   1 < \alpha < \beta   。
(a) 以   \log_{\beta} \beta   表   \log_{\beta} \alpha   。
(b) 若   \log_{\beta} \alpha, \log_{\beta} \beta, \log_{\alpha} \beta   為一等差數列，求該等差數列的公差。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Suppose \alpha, \beta are a geometric sequence, where 1 < \alpha < \beta.

(a) Express \log_{\beta} \alpha in terms of \log_{\beta} \beta.

(b) If \log_{\beta} \alpha, \log_{\beta} \beta, \log_{\alpha} \beta are an arithmetic sequence, find the common difference of the arithmetic sequence.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
18a)
\begin{aligned}
    \frac{\beta}{7}=\frac{7}{\alpha} \\
    \alpha\beta=49 \\
    \log_{7}\alpha\beta=\log_{7}49 \\
    \log_{7}\alpha+\log_{7}\beta=2 \\
    \log_{7}\alpha=2-\log_{7}\beta
\end{aligned}

18b)
\begin{aligned}
    \log_{\alpha}\beta-\log_{\gamma}\beta=\log_{\gamma}\beta-\log_{\beta}\alpha \\
    \frac{\log_{7}\beta}{\log_{7}\alpha}-\log_{7}\beta=\log_{7}\beta-\frac{\log_{7}\alpha}{\log_{7}\beta} \\
    \text{設}\quad u=\log_{7}\beta\quad。 \\
    \frac{u}{2-u}-u=u-\frac{2-u}{u}\quad\text{(藉(a))} \\
    \frac{u^{2}-u}{2-u}=\frac{u^{2}+u-2}{u} \\
    \frac{u(u-1)}{2-u}=\frac{(u+2)(u-1)}{u} \\
    u^{2}=(u+2)(2-u)\quad(\text{由於}u\neq1] \\
    u^{2}=2 \\
    u=\sqrt{2}\quad{\text{或}}\quad u=-\sqrt{2}\quad({\text{ 捨去 }}) \\
    \log_{7}\beta=\sqrt{2} \\
    \text{該等差數列的公差} \\
    =\log_{7}\beta-\log_{\beta}\alpha \\
    =\log_{7}\beta-\frac{\log_{7}\alpha}{\log_{7}\beta} \\
    =\log_{7}\beta-\frac{2-\log_{7}\beta}{\log_{7}\beta} \\
    =\sqrt{2}-\frac{2-\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}} \\
    =1
\end{aligned}
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
"18a)
\begin{aligned}
 \frac{\beta}{7}=\frac{7}{\alpha} \\
 \alpha\beta=49 \\
 \log_{7}\alpha\beta=\log_{7}49 \\
 \log_{7}\alpha+\log_{7}\beta=2 \\
 \log_{7}\alpha=2-\log_{7}\beta
\end{aligned}

18b)
\begin{aligned}
 \log_{\alpha}\beta-\log_{\gamma}\beta=\log_{\gamma}\beta-\log_{\beta}\alpha \\
 \frac{\log_{7}\beta}{\log_{7}\alpha}-\log_{7}\beta=\log_{7}\beta-\frac{\log_{7}\alpha}{\log_{7}\beta} \\
 \text{Suppose}\quad u=\log_{7}\beta\quad. \\
 \frac{u}{2-u}-u=u-\frac{2-u}{u}\quad\text{(borrow(a))} \\
 \frac{u^{2}-u}{2-u}=\frac{u^{2}+u-2}{u} \\
 \frac{u(u-1)}{2-u}=\frac{(u+2)(u-1)}{u} \\
 u^{2}=(u+2)(2-u)\quad(\text{due}u\neq1] \\

 u^{2}=2 \\

 u=\sqrt{2}\quad{\text{or}}\quad u=-\sqrt{2}\quad({\text{discarded}}) \\

 \log_{7}\beta=\sqrt{2} \\

 \text{the common difference of the arithmetic sequence} \\

 =\log_{7}\beta-\log_{\beta}\alpha \\

 =\log_{7}\beta-\frac{\log_{7}\alpha}{\log_{7}\beta} \\

 =\log_{7}\beta-\frac{2-\log_{7}\beta}{\log_{7}\beta} \\

 =\sqrt{2}-\frac{2-\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}} \\
 =1
\end{aligned}"

(b) (i) 以 n 表第 n 年年終時所有公屋單位的總樓面面積。(ii) 哪一年年終時所有公屋單位的總樓面面積會首次超過 4×10^7 m²？
(c) 現假設第 n 年終時所需公屋單位的總樓面積為 (a(1.21)^{n}+b)m^{2} ，其中 a 及 b 均爲常數。某些研究結果顯示下列資料：

|  n  | 第 n 年終時所需公屋單位的總樓面積( m^{2} ) |
|-----|---------------------------------------------|
| 1   |  1\times10^{7}                                |
| 2   |  1.063\times10^{7}                              |

一研究助理宣稱基於上述假設，某年終時所有公屋單位的總樓面積會大於所需公屋單位的總樓面積。該宣稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。（4分）
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"This study investigates the development of public housing in a certain city. The total floor area of ​​public housing units demolished each year is 3 × 10⁵ m². It is now known that at the end of year 3, the total floor area of ​​all public housing units is 1.026 × 10⁷ m².

(a) (i) Let r represent the total floor area of ​​all public housing units at the end of year 2.

(ii) Calculate r.

(b) (i) Let n represent the total floor area of ​​all public housing units at the end of year n. (ii) In which year will the total floor area of ​​all public housing units first exceed 4 × 10⁷?" m²?

(c) Assume that the total floor area of ​​public housing units required at the end of year n is (a(1.21)^{n}+b)m^{2}, where a and b are constants. Some research results show the following data:

| n | Total floor area of ​​public housing units required at the end of year n (m^{2}) |

|-----|---------------------------------------------|

| 1 | 1\times10^{7} |

| 2 | 1.063\times10^{7} |

A research assistant claims that based on the above assumption, the total floor area of ​​all public housing units at the end of a certain year will be greater than the total floor area of ​​required public housing units. Is this claim correct? Explain your answer. (4 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
19ai)
The required area
  = 9 \times 10^{6} (1 + r  \%) - 3 \times 10^{5}  
  
= (870 + 9r) \times 10^{4} \text{ m}^{2}  

19aii)
\begin{aligned}
    (9\times10^{6}(1+r \%)-3\times10^{5})(1+r \%)-3\times10^{5}=1.026\times10^{7} \\
    150(1+r \%)^{2}-5(1+r \%)-176=0 \\
    1+r \%=\frac{11}{10}\quad\mathrm{or}\quad1+r \%=\frac{-16}{15}(\mathrm{rejected}) \\
    \mathrm{Thus,\(\sim\)we\(\sim\)have}r=10.
\end{aligned}

19bi)
The required area
  =9\times10^6(1.1)^{n-1}-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-2}-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-3}-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-4}-\cdots-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-6}  
  
=9\times10^6(1.1)^{n-1}-3\times10^5\left(\frac{(1.1)^{n-1}-1}{1.1-1}\right)  
  =9\times10^6(1.1)^{n-1}-3\times10^5((1.1)^{n-1}-1)  
  
=(6(1.1)^{n-1}+3)\times10^6\text{ m}^2  

19bi)
The required area
  =9\times10^6(1.1)^{n-1}-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-2}-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-3}-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-4}-\cdots-3\times10^5(1.1)^{n-6}  
  
=9\times10^6(1.1)^{n-1}-3\times10^5\left(\frac{(1.1)^{n-1}-1}{1.1-1}\right)  
  =9\times10^6(1.1)^{n-1}-3\times10^5((1.1)^{n-1}-1)  
  
=(6(1.1)^{n-1}+3)\times10^6\text{ m}^2  

19bii)
When  (6(1.1)^{n-1}+3)\times 10^6 > 4\times 10^7  , we have  (1.1)^{n-1} > \frac{37}{6}  .

Hence, we have  \log(1.1)^{n-1} > \log\left(\frac{37}{6}\right)  .

Solving, we have  n > 20.08671715  .

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
設1994年內香港出生的嬰兒的數目為70,000，並且在隨後的年份裏，每年出生嬰兒的數目較其前一年增加2\%。

(a) (i) 求1994年後的第1年內香港出生的嬰兒的數目。
(ii) 求1994年後的第n年內香港出生的嬰兒的數目。(2分)

(b) 在哪一年香港出生的嬰兒的數目首次超過90,000？(3分)

(c) 求由1997至2046（包括首尾兩年）在香港出生的嬰兒的總數。(3分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn: Suppose that 70,000 babies were born in Hong Kong in 1994, and that the number of babies born each year thereafter increases by 2\\% compared to the previous year. (a) (i) Find the number of babies born in Hong Kong in the first year after 1994. (ii) Find the number of babies born in Hong Kong in the nth year after 1994. (2 points) (b) In which year did the number of babies born in Hong Kong first exceed 90,000? (3 points) (c) Find the total number of babies born in Hong Kong from 1997 to 2046 (inclusive). (3 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
15ai)
The number of babies born in Hong Kong
in the first year after 1994
= 70000×1.02
= 71400

15aii)
The number of babies born in Hong Kong in the nth year after 1994

$
= 70000(1.02)^n 
$

b)
If $70000(1.02)^{n} > 90000$

then $n \log (1.02) > \log \left(\frac{9}{7}\right)$

$n > 12.69$

$\therefore$ In the 13th year after 1994, the number of babies born in Hong Kong will exceed 90000.
i.e. In the year 2007.

c)
The total number of babies born in Hong Kong in the years 1997 to 2046 inclusive
$$= 70000(1.02^{3}+1.02^{4}+...+1.02^{52})$$
$$
= 70000(1.02)^{3}(1+1.02+1.02^{2}+...+1.02^{49})$$
$$= 70000(1.02)^{3}\left(\frac{1.02^{50}-1}{1.02-1}\right)$$
$$
= 6282944$$
$$= 6280000$$

senior_secondary.questionText: \boxed{\text{直線 }L 1\text{ 的方程爲 }6x+7y=900\text{ 及直線 }L 2\text{ 的 }x\text{ 截距爲 180 。}L 1\text{ 與}}   L 2  相 交 於 點 (45,90) 。 陰 影 區 域 ( 包 括 邊 界 在 內 ) 表 示 某 不 等 式 組 的 解 。 求 該 不 等 式 組 。(4 分 )
senior_secondary.questionTextEn: In  the equation of line L_1 is 6x + 7y = 900, and the x-intercept of line L_2 is 180. L_1 and L_2 intersect at the point (45, 90). The shaded region (including the boundary) represents the solution to a system of inequalities. Find the system of inequalities. (4 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
“L_2 的斜率

= \frac{90-0}{45-180}



= \frac{-2}{3}

L_2 的方程式為

y-90=\frac{-2}{3}(x-45)


2x+3y-360=0

因此，不等式組為

\begin{cases}

6x+7y\leq900 \\

2x+3y\leq360 \\

x\geq0 \\

y\geq0

\end{cases}.”
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
The slope of  L 2 
  = \frac{90-0}{45-180}  
  
= \frac{-2}{3}  
The equation of  L 2  is
  y-90=\frac{-2}{3}(x-45)  
  
2x+3y-360=0  
Thus, the system of inequalities is
  \begin{cases}
6x+7y\leq900 \\
2x+3y\leq360 \\
x\geq0 \\
y\geq0
\end{cases}.

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
某工廠生產 X及Y兩款衣櫃。 每個X 衣櫃 6 工時裝嵌 2 工時包裝,而 每個 Y 衣櫃 7 工時裝嵌及 3 工時包裝。 在某月,該工廠有 900 工時可作 裝嵌及 360 工時可作包裝。 生產一個X 衣櫃及一個Y衣櫃的利潤分別為  440及 665。某工人宣稱該月的總利潤可超過  80000 你是否同意? 試解釋你的答案。
 (4分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn: A factory produces two types of wardrobes, X and Y. Each wardrobe X requires 6 hours of assembly and 2 hours of packaging, while each wardrobe Y requires 7 hours of assembly and 3 hours of packaging. In a certain month, the factory has 900 hours available for assembly and 360 hours for packaging. The profit from producing one wardrobe X and one wardrobe Y is 440 and 665 respectively. A worker claims that the total profit for that month could exceed 80,000. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Let  x  and  y  be the numbers of wardrobes  X  and  Y  produced that
month respectively.
Now,the constraints are  6x+7y\leq900  and 2 x+3y\leq360 ,where  x  and  y  are non-negative integers.
Denote the total profit on the production of wardrobes by  P\(\sim\).
Then, we have  P= 440x+ 665y  .
Note that the vertices of the shaded region in Figure 7 are the points
(0,0) , (0,120) , (45,90) and (150,0) .
At the point (0,0) ,we have  P=(440)(0)+(665)(0)=0. 
At the point (0,120) ,we have  P=(440)(0)+(665)(120)=79800  At the point (45,90) ,we have  P=(440)(45)+(665)(90)=79650  At the point (150,0) ,we have  P=(440)(150)+(665)(0)=6600  So, the greatest possible profit is  79 800.
Thus, the claim is disagreed.

senior_secondary.questionTextEn: A restaurant has two types of dining tables: square tables and round tables. The restaurant manager wants to place at least 8 square tables and 10 round tables. Furthermore, the number of round tables should not exceed twice the number of square tables. Each square table occupies 4 m² of floor space, and each round table occupies 8 m² of floor space. The maximum floor space occupied by the tables in the restaurant is 240 m². On a certain day, the profit from each square table is 4000, and the profit from each round table is 6000. The restaurant manager claims that the total profit from the tables on that day will exceed 230,000. Do you agree? Please explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Let  x and y  be the numbers of square tables and round tables placed respectively.

Now, the constraints are  x \geq 8, y \geq 10, 2x \geq y and x + 2y \leq 60 

Denote the total profit on the dining tables by  \ P .

Then, we have P = 4000x + 6000y .

Note that the vertices of the shaded region are (12, 24), (40, 10), (8, 10) and (8, 16) .

At (12, 24) , we have P = (4000)(12) + (6000)(24) = 192000 .

At (40, 10) , we have P = (4000)(40) + (6000)(10) = 220000 .

At (8, 10) , we have P = (4000)(8) + (6000)(10) = 92000 .

At (8, 16) , we have P = (4000)(8) + (6000)(16) = 128000 .

So, the greatest value of P is 220000 .

Thus, the claim is disagreed.

(b) Selling a tray of cookies yields a profit of 90, while selling a tray of pastries yields a profit of 120. If x and y are integers, find the maximum possible profit. (4 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
18a)

表示 x 和 y 限制的不等式：

x \geq 0, y \geq 0

對區域 R 進行陰影處理。

= 30(3x + 4y)

= 1500

18a)
The inequalities representing the constraints for  x  and  y :

 x \geq 0 ,  y \geq 0

= 30(3x + 4y)

留意    \angle   BAH =   \angle   ABG  及    \angle   BAG =   \angle   ABG 。

senior_secondary.questionText:
圖6中，$\Delta PQR$ 為一等腰三角形且 $PQ=PR$。已知 $S$ 爲 $QR$ 上的一點及 $\Delta PQR$ 的垂心在 $PS$ 上。在圖 6 中引入一直角坐標系使得 $P$ 及 $Q$ 的坐標分別為 $(16,80)$ 及 $(-32,-48)$。
(a) 求 $PR$ 的垂直平分線的方程。
(b) 求 $\triangle PQR$ 的外心的座標。
(c) 設 $C$ 爲通過 $P$、$Q$ 及 $R$ 的圓。
(i) 求 $C$ 的方程。
(ii) $C$ 的圓心與 $\triangle PQR$ 的內心是否同一點？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
In Figure 6, \Delta PQR is an isosceles triangle with PQ=PR. S is a point on QR, and the orthocenter of \Delta PQR lies on PS. Introduce a rectangular coordinate system in Figure 6 such that the coordinates of P and Q are (16,80) and (-32,-48), respectively.

(a) Find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of PR.

(b) Find the coordinates of the circumcenter of \triangle PQR.

(c) Let C be a circle passing through P, Q, and R.

(i) Find the equation of C.

(ii) Is the center of C the same point as the incenter of \triangle PQR? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
16a)

點 R 的座標為 (64, -48)。

因此，線段 PR 的中點座標為 (40, 16)。

線段 PR 的斜率

= (80 + 48) / (16 - 64)

= -8 / (3)

因此，線段 PR 的垂直平分線的斜率為 3 / (8)。

線段 PR 的垂直平分線的方程式為：

y - 16 = 3 / (8) (x - 40)

3x - 8y + 8 = 0

16b)

請注意，三角形 PQR 的外心是直線 PS 與線段 PR 的垂直平分線的交點。

設三角形 PQR 的外心座標為 (16, h)。 PQR。

由於 (16, h) 位於直線 3x-8y+8=0 上，因此有 3(16)-8h+8=0。

所以，h=7。

因此，三角形 PQR 的外心座標為 (16, 7)。

16ci)

圓心座標為

= (16, 7)

圓心半徑為

= 80 - 7

= 73

因此，圓心方程式為 (x-16)² + (y-7)² = 73²。

16cii)

設 N 為三角形 PQR 的外心。

由 (b) 可知，N = (16, 7)。

如果圓心和內心…如果 \Delta PQR 的圓心和中心點是同一個點，那麼 \Delta PQR 的外心和中心點也是同一個點。

設 M 為 PR 的中點。

由 (a) 可知，M = (40, 16)。

又知，S = (16, -48)。

NS = 7 - (-48) = 55

NM = \sqrt{(40 - 16)^2 + (16 - 7)^2} = \sqrt{657}

由於 NS \neq NM，所以 N 不是 \Delta PQR 的中心點。

因此，C 的中心和 \Delta PQR 的中心點不是同一個點。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
16a)
The coordinates of $R$ are $(64, -48)$.
So, the coordinates of the mid-point of $PR$ are $(40, 16)$.
The slope of $PR$
$=\frac{80+48}{16-64}$
$=\frac{-8}{3}$
Therefore, the slope of the perpendicular bisector of $PR$ is $\frac{3}{8}$.
The equation of the perpendicular bisector of $PR$ is
$y-16=\frac{3}{8}(x-40)$
$3x-8y+8=0$

16b)
Note that the circumcentre of $\Delta PQR$ is the point of intersection of $PS$ and the perpendicular bisector of $PR$.
Let $(16, h)$ be the coordinates of the circumcentre of $\Delta PQR$.
Since $(16, h)$ lies on $3x-8y+8=0$, we have $3(16)-8h+8=0$.
So, we have $h=7$.
Thus, the coordinates of the circumcentre of $\Delta PQR$ are $(16, 7)$.

16ci)
The coordinates of the centre of $C$
$= (16, 7)$
The radius of $C$
$= 80 - 7$
$= 73$
Thus, the equation of $C$ is $(x-16)^2 + (y-7)^2 = 73^2$.

16cii)
Let $N$ be the circumcentre of $\Delta PQR$.
By (b), we have $N = (16, 7)$.
If the centre of $C$ and the in-centre of $\Delta PQR$ are the same point, then the circumcentre and the in-centre of $\Delta PQR$ are the same point.
Let $M$ be the mid-point of $PR$.
By (a), we have $M = (40, 16)$.
Also, we have $S = (16, -48)$.
$$NS = 7 - (-48) = 55$$
$$
NM = \sqrt{(40 - 16)^2 + (16 - 7)^2} = \sqrt{657}$$
Since $NS \neq NM$, $N$ is not the in-centre of $\Delta PQR$.
Thus, the centre of $C$ and the in-centre of $\Delta PQR$ are not the same point.

(L3)...   \angle PQO = \frac{1}{2} \angle PCO = 30°   (∠ at centre twice ∠ at circumference)

16b)
(L14)...  \angle ROQ = \angle QOP = 30^\circ  (tangents from ext. pt.)
(L15)...  \angle PQO = 30^\circ  (proved)
(L16)...  \therefore \angle RQP + \angle POR = 180^\circ  (opp.  \angle s of cyclic quad.)
(L17)...  \therefore \angle CQR = 180^\circ - 3 \times 30^\circ = 90^\circ 
(L18)... Hence  RQ  is tangent to circle  PQS  at  Q . (conv. of tangent  \perp  radius)
16c)
  \therefore \text{Slope of } OC = \frac{4}{3}  
  
\therefore \text{Slope of } QR = -\frac{3}{4}  
  OC = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = 10  
  
CQ = CP = OC \sin 30^\circ = 5  
Let the coordinates of  Q  be  (x, y) .
  OC : CQ = 10 : 5 = 2 : 1  
  
\therefore \frac{2x + 1(0)}{3} = 6 \text{ and } \frac{2y + 1(0)}{3} = 8  
Equation of circle:
  (x - 6)^2 + (y - 8)^2 = 25  
  
x^2 + y^2 - 12x - 16y + 75 = 0 \quad \text{......(1)}  
Equation of  OC :
  y = \frac{4}{3}x \quad \text{......(2)}  
Solving (1) and (2),   
x^2 - 12x + 27 = 0 \quad \text{(or } y^2 - 16y + 48 = 0 \text{)}  
  x = 3 \text{ (rej.) or 9} \quad \text{(or } y = 4 \text{ (rej.) or 12} \text{)}  
  
x = 9 \text{ and } y = 12  
Hence the equation of  QR  is
  \frac{y - 12}{x - 9} = -\frac{3}{4}  
  
3x + 4y - 75 = 0 \quad \text{(or } y = -\frac{3}{4}x + \frac{75}{4} \text{)}

(a) 求直線AB的方程。 (2分)

(b) 求AB的垂直平分線的方程，由此求G的座標。(5分)

(c) 求圓 \mathcal{E} 的方程。 (2分)

(d) 若DE(圓5中已標示)為圓 \mathcal{E} 的另一弦，且AB和DE等長及平行，求

(i) DE中點的座標；

(ii) 直線DE的方程。 (3分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Points A(1,9) and B(9,7) lie on the circle \mathcal{E}, and the center G lies on the line l: 4x-3y+12=0.

(a) Find the equation of line AB. (2 points)

(b) Find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of AB, and from this, find the coordinates of G. (5 points)

(c) Find the equation of the circle \mathcal{E}. (2 points)

(d) If DE (marked in circle 5) is another chord of the circle \mathcal{E}, and AB and DE are of equal length and parallel, find:

(i) the coordinates of the midpoint of DE;

(ii) the equation of line DE. (3 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
10a)
Equation of AB :  \frac{y-9}{x-1} = \frac{7-9}{9-1} 

 y-9=-\frac{1}{4}(x-1) 

 y=-\frac{x}{4}+\frac{37}{4}  (or  x+4y=37 )

10b)
Mid-point of AB = (5,8)
Slope of the perpendicular bisector of AB = 4
Equation of the perpendicular bisector of AB is
y-8=4(x-5)
y=4x-12
OR
(x-1)²+(y-9)²=(x-9)²+(y-7)²
16x-4y-48=0
4x-y-12=0

Solving y=4x-12 and 4x-3y+12=0,
we have 4x-3(4x-12)+12=0
x=6, y=12
∴ G = (6,12)

10c)
Equation of the circle is
  (x-6)^{2}+(y-12)^{2}+(6-1)^{2}+(12-9)^{2}  
  
(x-6)^{2}+(y-12)^{2}=34  
or
  x^{2}+y^{2}-12x-24y+146=0  

10di)
Let the mid-point of DE be (x,y), then
  \frac{x+5}{2}=6, \quad \frac{y+8}{2}=12  
  
x=7, y=16  

10dii)
Equation of  DE  is
  y-16=-\frac{1}{4}(x-7)  
  
x+4y-71=0

senior_secondary.questionText:
佩琀及志偉參與一含兩回合的遊戲。在第一回合，佩琦及志偉輪流投擲一枚勻稱骰子。首位擲得點數「3」的參與者勝出第一回合。佩瑲及志偉參與第一回合，直至其中一人勝出爲止。佩琦首先投擲骰子 。

## (3 分)

 ( \mathfrak{a} )  求佩琦勝出該遊戲第一回合的概率 。

(b) 在該遊戲的第二回合，球被逐一投入某部由八個管子並列所組成的裝置內(見
圖 8) 。 當球被投入該裝置時 ,它會隨機跌進其中一管子內 。 每個管子最多可容

納三個球。
(ii)

這回合的參與者探納下列兩個選項中的一個 。
選項 1: 將兩個球逐一投入該裝置內。若該兩個球跌進同一管子內 ,則該參與
者獲 10 個代幣；若該兩個球跌進兩個相鄰的管子內 ,則該參與者
獲 5 個代幣；否則，該參與者不獲代幣 。
選項 2: 將三個球逐一投入該裝置內。若該三個球跌進同一管子內，則該參與
者獲 50 個代幣；若該三個球跌進三個相鄰的管子內 ,則該參與者獲 10 個代幣；若該三個球跌進兩個相鄰的管子內，則該參與者獲 5 個代幣；否則，該參與者不獲代幣。
( i)  若第二回合的參與者探納選項 1 ,求所獲代幣的數目的期望値 。
第二回合的參與者應採納哪一選項才使所獲代幣的數目的期望値達至最大 ?
試解釋你的答案 。
(iii) 只有第一回合的勝方參與第二回合。 已知第二回合的參與者採納能使所獲代
幣的數目的期望值達至最大的選項。 志偉宣稱佩琀在該遊戲中不獲代幣的概
率超過 0.9 。 該宣稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案 。
(10 分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"Peihan and Zhiwei participate in a two-round game. In the first round, Peihan and Zhiwei take turns rolling a fair die. The first participant to roll a "3" wins the first round. Peihan and Zhiwei participate in the first round until one of them wins. Peihan rolls the die first.

## (3 points)

( \mathfrak{a} ) Find the probability that Peihan wins the first round of the game.

(b) In the second round of the game, balls are thrown one by one into a device consisting of eight tubes arranged side by side (see Figure 8). When a ball is thrown into the device, it will randomly fall into one of the tubes. Each tube can hold a maximum of three balls.

(ii)

The participants in this round choose one of the following two options.

Option 1: Throw two balls one by one into the device." If the two balls fall into the same tube, the participant receives 10 tokens; if the two balls fall into two adjacent tubes, the participant receives 5 tokens; otherwise, the participant receives no tokens.

Option 2: Drop the three balls into the device one by one. If the three balls fall into the same tube, the participant receives 50 tokens; if the three balls fall into three adjacent tubes, the participant receives 10 tokens; if the three balls fall into two adjacent tubes, the participant receives 5 tokens; otherwise, the participant receives no tokens.

(i) If the participant in the second round chooses Option 1, calculate the expected value of the number of tokens they receive.

Which option should the participant in the second round choose to maximize the expected value of the number of tokens they receive? Explain your answer.

(iii) Only the winner of the first round participates in the second round. It is known that in the second round, the participants adopted the option that maximized the expected value of the number of tokens they received. Zhiwei claims that Peihan's probability of not receiving any tokens in this game is greater than 0.9. Is this claim correct? Explain your answer.

(10 points)

9ai)

僅

設 p(x)=6x^4+7x^3+ax^2+bx+c  ,其中 a  、 b 及 c 均為常數。當 p(x) 除以 x+2 時及當 p(x)除以 x-2 時，所得的兩餘數相等。已知 p( x) \equiv ( lx^2+ 5x+ 8) ( 2x^2+ mx+ n)  , 其中 l  、 m 及 n 均為常數 。
(a) 求 l  、m 及 n  。
(b) 方程 p(x)=0 有多少個實根？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Let p(x) = 6x^4 + 7x^3 + ax^2 + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants. The remainders are equal when p(x) is divided by x + 2 and when p(x) is divided by x - 2. Given p(x) \equiv (lx^2 + 5x + 8)(2x^2 + mx + n), where l, m, and n are constants.

(a) Find l, m, and n.

(b) How many real roots does the equation p(x) = 0 have? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
留意  p( 2) = 152+ 4a+ 2b+ c  及 p ( - 2) = 40+ 4a- 2b+ c  
由於 p(2)=p(-2) ,可得  b= - 28  


藉比較 x^4 的係數，可得 l= 3  

留意在 (3x^2+5x+8)(2x^2+mx+n) 的展開式中 x^3 及 x 的係數

分別為 3m+10 及 8 m+5n  。

故此，可得 3 m+ 10= 7  及 8 m+ 5n= - 28  

求解後，可得 m=-1 及 n=-4 

b)
p(x)=0
(3x²+5x+8)(2x²-x-4)=0  （藉(a)）
3x²+5x+8=0 或 2x²-x-4=0
 5^2-4(3)(8) 
=-71
<0
故此，二次方程 3x²+5x+8=0 沒有實根。
 (-1)^2-4(2)(-4) 
=33
\>0
所以，二次方程 2x²-x-4=0 有 2 個實根。
由此，方程 (3x²+5x+8)(2x²-x-4)=0 有 2 個實根。
因此，方程 p(x)=0 有 2 個實根。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
14a)

Note that p(2) = 152 + 4a + 2b + c and p(-2) = 40 + 4a - 2b + c.

Since p(2) = p(-2), we can get b = -28.

By comparing the coefficients of x^4, we can get l = 3.

Note that in the expansion of (3x^2 + 5x + 8)(2x^2 + mx + n), the coefficients of x^3 and x are 3m + 10 and 8m + 5n respectively.

Therefore, we can get 3m + 10 = 7 and 8m + 5n = -28. After solving, we get m=-1 and n=-4.

14b)

p(x)=0

(3x²+5x+8)(2x²-x-4)=0 (borrowing (a))

3x²+5x+8=0 or 2x²-x-4=0

Therefore, the equation p(x)=0 has 2 real roots.

設f( x) = 6 x^3 - 13 x^2 - 46x+ 34 。當 f (x) 除以 2x^2+ax+4 時，商式及餘式分別為 3x+7 
及 bx+c  ,其中 a  、 b 及 c 均為常數 。
(a) 求 a  。
( b)  設 g(x) 為二次多項式使得當 g(x)除以 2x^2+ax+4 時，餘式為 bx+ c  。
( i)  證明 f( x) - g( x)  可被  2x^2+ ax+ 4  整除。
(ii) 某人宣稱方程 f (x)-g(x)=0 所有的根均為整數 。 你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Let f(x) = 6x³ - 13x² - 46x + 34. When f(x) is divided by 2x² + ax + 4, the quotient and remainder are 3x + 7 and bx + c, respectively, where a, b, and c are constants.

(a) Find a.

(b) Let g(x) be a quadratic polynomial such that when g(x) is divided by 2x² + ax + 4, the remainder is bx + c.

(i) Prove that f(x) - g(x) is divisible by 2x² + ax + 4.

(ii) Someone claims that all roots of the equation f(x) - g(x) = 0 are integers. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
\begin{aligned}
    \mathrm{f}(x) \\
    =\left(3x+7\right)\left(2x^{2}+ax+4\right)+bx+c \\
    =6x^{3}+\left(3a+14\right)x^{2}+\left(12+7a+b\right)x+28+c \\
    \equiv6x^{3}-13x^{2}-46x+34 \\
    3a+14=-13 \\
    a=-9
\end{aligned}

bi)
  \text{Since } g(x) \text{ is a quadratic polynomial, degree of quotient when } g(x) \text{ is divided by } 2x^2 + ax + 4 \text{ is 0}  
  
g(x) = A(2x^2 - 9x + 4) + bx + c, \text{ where } A \text{ is a constant}  
  f(x) - g(x)  
  
= (3x + 7)(2x^2 + ax + 4) + bx + c - (A(2x^2 - 9x + 4) + bx + c)  
  = (3x + 7 - A)(2x^2 + ax + 4)  
  
\therefore f(x) - g(x) \text{ is divisible by } 2x^2 + ax + 4  

bii)
Let the equation of  C  be  (x-4)^2+(y+1)^2=r , where  r  is a real constant

Since  C  passes through (−6,5),

So, we have  (-6-2)^2+(5+1)^2=r 

 r=100 

The equation of  C :  (x-4)^2+(y+1)^2=100
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
14a)

\begin{aligned}

 \mathrm{f}(x) \\

 =\left(3x+7\right)\left(2x^{2}+ax+4\right)+bx+c \\

 =6x^{3}+\left(3a+14\right)x^{2}+\left(12+7a+b\right)x+28+c \\

 \equiv6x^{3}-13x^{2}-46x+34 \\

 3a+14=-13 \\

 a=-9

\end{aligned}

14bi)

\text{由於} g(x) \text{ 是二次多項式，當} g(x) \text{ 除以} 2x^2 + ax + 4 \text{ 時，商數的次數為0}



g(x) = A(2x^2 - 9x + 4) + bx + c, \text{ 其中 } A \text{ 為常數}

f(x) - g(x)



= (3x + 7)(2x^2 + ax + 4) + bx + c - (A(2x^2 - 9x + 4) + bx + c)

= (3x + 7 - A)(2x^2 + ax + 4)



因此 f(x) - g(x) \text{ 可被 } 2x^2 + ax + 4 整除

由於 C 經過(−6,5)

因此，我們有 (-6-2)^2+(5+1)^2=r

r=100

C 的方程式為：(x-4)^2+(y+1)^2=100

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
設  p(x)  為三次多項式。當  p(x)  除以  x-1  時，餘數為 50。當  p(x)  除以  x+2  時，餘數為 -52。已知  p(x)  可被  2x^2 + 9x + 14  整除。
(a) 求  p(x)  除以  2x^2 + 9x + 14  時的商式。（3分）
(b) 方程  p(x)=0  有多少個有理根？試解釋你的答案。（3分）
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Let p(x) be a cubic polynomial. When p(x) is divided by x-1, the remainder is 50. When p(x) is divided by x+2, the remainder is -52. p(x) is divisible by 2x^2 + 9x + 14.

(a) Find the quotient when p(x) is divided by 2x^2 + 9x + 14. (3 points)

(b) How many rational roots does the equation p(x)=0 have? Explain your answer. (3 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
11a) Let ax+b be the quotient we are looking for, where a and b are constants. Then we have p(x)=(ax+b)(2x^{2}+9x+14).

Note that p(1)=50 and p(-2)=-52.

Therefore, we have (a(1)+b)(2(1)^{2}+9(1)+14)=50 and (a(-2)+b)(2(-2)^{2}+9(-2)+14)=-52.

So we have a+b=2 and -2a+b=-13.

After solving, we have a=5 and b=-3.

Therefore, the quotient we are looking for is 5x-3. .

11b)
\begin{array}{l} p(x)=0 \\ (5x-3)(2x^{2}+9x+14)=0 \quad \text{（borrow (a)）} \\ 5x-3=0 \text{ or } 2x^{2}+9x+14=0 \\ 9^{2}-4(2)(14) \\ =-31 \\ <0 \end{array}

\text{Therefore, the quadratic equation } 2x^{2}+9x+14=0 \text{ has no real roots. }
\text{Note } \frac{3}{5} \text{ is a rational root of the equation } p(x)=0 \text{. }

\text{Therefore, the equation } p(x)=0 \text{ has 1 rational root. }"

senior_secondary.questionText:
三次多項式 f(x) 可被 x-1 整除。當 f (x) 除以 x^2-1 時，餘式為 kx+8  ,其中 k 為一常數。
(a)求 k  。
(b) 已知 x+3 為f ( x) 的因式。當f ( x) 除以 x 時，餘數為 24 。 某人宣稱
方程f ( x) = 0 所有的根均為整數 。 該宣稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
A cubic polynomial f(x) is divisible by x-1. When f(x) is divided by x^2-1, the remainder is kx+8, where k is a constant.

(a) Find k.

(b) Given that x+3 is a factor of f(x), and when f(x) is divided by x, the remainder is 24. Someone claims that all roots of the equation f(x) = 0 are integers. Is this claim correct? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
13a) Let f(x) = (x^2-1)q(x) + (kx+8) , where q(x) is a polynomial. Since f(1) = 0, we can get (1^2-1)q(1) + (k+8) = 0. Therefore, we can get k = -8.

13b) Let f(x) = (x−1)(x+3)(ax+b), where a and b are constants. Since f(0) = 24, we can get (−1)(3)(b) = 24. Solving, we get b = −8. Note that f(x) = (x^2−1)q(x) + (−8x+8). Therefore, we can get... f(−1) = ((−1)^2−1)q(−1) + ((−8)(−1) + 8) = 16.

Therefore, we can obtain (−1−1)(−1+3)(−a−8) = 16.

Solving this problem, we get a = −4.

Thus, we can obtain f(x) = (x−1)(x+3)(−4x−8).

The roots of the equation f(x) = 0 are 1, −3, and −2.

All roots of the equation f(x) = 0 are integers.

Therefore, this claim is correct.

senior_secondary.questionTextEn:

senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
12a)
  p(x) \equiv (x^2 + x + 1)(2x^2 - 37) + cx + c - 1 .  
  
p(5) = 0

6c + 402 = 0  
  c = -67  

12b)
\begin{aligned}
    p(x) \\
    =(x^{2}+x+1)(2x^{2}-37)-67x-68 \\
    =2x^{4}+2x^{3}-35x^{2}-104x-105 \\
    p(-3) \\
    =2(-3)^{4}+2(-3)^{3}-35(-3)^{2}-104(-3)-105 \\
    =0 \\
    \therefore x+3\textbf{ is a factor of }p(x).
\end{aligned}

12c)
By (b), we have  p(x) = 2x^4 + 2x^3 - 35x^2 - 104x - 105 .
By long division, we have
  p(x) = (x + 3)(x - 5)(2x^2 + 6x + 7)  

 p(x) = 0 

 (x + 3)(x - 5)(2x^2 + 6x + 7) = 0 

 x = -3, x = 5  or  2x^2 + 6x + 7 = 0

 = -20 

 < 0

senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Let p(x) = 2x^3 + ax^2 + bx - 20, where a and b are constants. When p(x) is divided by x^2 - 2x + 3, the remainder is x + 13.

(a) Find a and b. (3 points)

(b) Is x - 5 a factor of p(x)? Explain your answer. (2 points)

(c) Someone claims that the equation p(x) = 0 has two irrational roots. Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
14a)
Let  p(x) = (cx + d)(x^2 - 2x + 3) + x + 13 , where  c  and  d  are constants.
 p(x) = cx^3 + (d - 2c)x^2 + (3c - 2d + 1)x + (3d + 13) .
By comparing coefficients, we have  c = 2  and  3d + 13 = -20 .
Solving, we have  c = 2  and  d = -11 .
∴  p(x) = 2x^3 - 15x^2 + 29x - 20 .
∴  a = -15  and  b = 29 .
 p(5) 
 = 2(5)^3 - 15(5)^2 + 29(5) - 20 
 = 0 
∴  x - 5  is a factor of  p(x) .

14b)
  p(x) = 0  
  
(x - 5)(2x^2 - 5x + 4) = 0  
  x = 5 \ \text{or} \ 2x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0  
  
\Delta = (-5)^2 - 4(2)(4)  
  = -7  
  
< 0  
  \therefore 2x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0 \text{ has no irrational roots}.  
Also note that 5 is not an irrational number.
  
\therefore p(x) = 0 \text{ has no irrational roots}.  
  \therefore \text{The claim is disagreed.}

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
定義 g(x)=x^3+5x^2-12x-1  。 設 h(x)=3x^4+ax^3-16x^2+bx+c  ,其中 a  、 b 及 c 均為常數。當 h (x) 除以 g(x) 時，商式與餘式相等 。
(a) 求當 h (x) 除以 g(x) 時的商式 。
(b) 方程 h ( x) = 0  有多少個有理根？試解釋你的答案 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Define g(x) = x^3 + 5x^2 - 12x - 1. Let h(x) = 3x^4 + ax^3 - 16x^2 + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants. When h(x) is divided by g(x), the quotient and remainder are equal.

(a) Find the quotient when h(x) is divided by g(x).

(b) How many rational roots does the equation h(x) = 0 have? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
13a)
設 mx+n 為所求的商式，其中 m 及 n 均為常數
則可得 h ( x) = ( mx+ n) ( x^{3}+ 5x^{2}- 12x- 1) + mx+ n  
藉比較 x^4 的係數，可得 m= 3  
藉比較 x^2 的係數，可得 5n-12m=-16 。
故此，可得 n= 4  
因此，所求的商式為 3 x+ 4 

13b)
  \begin{array}{l} h(x)=0 \\ (3x+4)\left(x^{3}+5x^{2}-12x-1\right)+3x+4=0 \quad \text { （藉 (a) ） } \\ (3x+4)\left(x^{3}+5x^{2}-12x\right)=0 \\ x(3x+4)\left(x^{2}+5x-12\right)=0 \\ x=0 \quad 、 \quad 3x+4=0 \text { 或 } x^{2}+5x-12=0 \\ x=0 \quad 、 \quad x=-\frac{4}{3} \text { 或 } x=\frac{-5 \pm \sqrt{73}}{2} \\ \text { 留意 } \frac{-5+\sqrt{73}}{2} \text { 及 } \frac{-5-\sqrt{73}}{2} \text { 均不是有理數。 } \\ \text { 再者留意 } \frac{-4}{3} \text { 及 } 0 \text { 均為 } h(x)=0 \text { 的有理根。 } \\ \text { 因此，方程 } h(x)=0 \text { 有 } 2 \text { 個有理根。 } \end{array}
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
13a) Let mx+n be the quotient we are looking for, where m and n are constants.

Then we get h(x) = (mx+n)(x^{3}+5x^{2}-12x-1) + mx+n.

By comparing the coefficients of x^4, we get m=3.

By comparing the coefficients of x^2, we get 5n-12m=-16.

Therefore, we get n=4.

So, the quotient we are looking for is 3x+4.

13b)
\begin{array}{l} h(x)=0 \\ (3x+4)\left(x^{3}+5x^{2}-12x-1\right)+3x+4=0 \quad \text { （借 (a) ） } \\ (3x+4)\left(x^{3}+5x^{2}-12x\right)=0 \\ x(3x+4)\left(x^{2}+5x-12\right)=0 \\ x=0 \quad 、 \quad 3x+4=0 \text { or } x^{2}+5x-12=0 \\ x=0 \quad 、 \quad x=-\frac{4}{3} \text { or } x=\frac{-5 \pm \sqrt{73}}{2} \\ \text { Note that } \frac{-5+\sqrt{73}}{2} \text { and } \frac{-5-\sqrt{73}}{2} \text { are not rational numbers. } \\ \text { Furthermore note } \frac{-4}{3} \text { and } 0 are all rational roots of h(x)=0. Therefore, the equation h(x)=0 has 2 rational roots.

senior_secondary.questionText:
f(x)=3x^3-7x^2+kx-8 ，其中 k 為常數。已知 f(x)=(x-2)(ax^2+bx+c) ，其中 a 、 b 及 c 均為常數。
(a) 求 a 、 b 及 c 。
(b) 某人宣稱方程 f(x)=0 所有的根均為實數。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Given the equation f(x) = 3x^3 - 7x^2 + kx - 8, where k is a constant. Also given is f(x) = (x - 2)(ax^2 + bx + c), where a, b, and c are all constants.

(a) Find a, b, and c.

(b) Someone claims that all roots of the equation f(x) = 0 are real numbers. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
12a)

透過比較 x^{3} 的係數和常數項的係數，我們得到：

a=3 和 c=4。

請注意，在 (x-2)(3x^{2}+bx+4) 的展開式中，x^{2} 的係數是 b-6。

透過比較 x^{2} 的係數，我們得到 b-6=-7。

因此，我們得到 b=-1。

12b)

\Delta = (-1)^2 - 4(3)(4) = -47 < 0

所以，方程式 3x^2 - x + 4 = 0 有非實根。因此，該結論不成立。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
12a)
By comparing the coefficients of  x^{3}  and the constant terms, we have
 a=3  and  c=4 .

Note that the coefficient of  x^{2}  in the expansion of  (x-2)(3x^{2}+bx+4)  is  b-6 .

By comparing the coefficients of  x^{2} , we have  b-6=-7 .

Thus, we have  b=-1 .

12b)
  \Delta = (-1)^2 - 4(3)(4) = -47 < 0  
So, the equation  3x^2 - x + 4 = 0  has nonreal roots. Thus, the claim is disagreed.

senior_secondary.questionText:
設 f (x)=(x-a)(x-b)(x+1)-3  ,其中 a 及 b 均爲正整數且 a<b  。已知 f(1)=1 。
( a)
( i) 證明  ( a- 1) ( b- 1) = 2  
(ii) 寫出 a 及 b 的值
(b) 設  g(x)=x^{3}-6x^{2}-2x+7  。利用 (a)(ii) 的結果，求  f(x)-g(x)  。由此求方程  f(x)=g(x)  所有根的真確值。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"Let f(x) = (x-a)(x-b)(x+1)-3, where a and b are both positive integers and a < b. Given f(1) = 1.

(a)

(i) Prove that (a-1)(b-1) = 2

(ii) Write down the values ​​of a and b

(b) Let g(x) = x^{3}-6x^{2}-2x+7. Using the results of (a) and (ii), find f(x)-g(x). Then find the true values ​​of all roots of the equation f(x)=g(x)."
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
10ai)
Note that   f(1)=(1-a)(1-b)(1+1)-3  .
 f(1)=1 
 2(1-a)(1-b)-3=1 
 (1-a)(1-b)=2 
Thus, we have  (a-1)(b-1)=2 .

10aii)
Since  a  and  b  are positive integers and  a<b , we have
 a-1=1  and  b-1=2 .
Thus, we have  a=2  and  b=3 .

10b)
  \begin{aligned} f(x)-g(x)   = (x-2)(x-3)(x+1)-3-(x^3-6x^2-2x+7) \\   = x^3-4x^2+x+3-x^3+6x^2+2x-7 \\   = 2x^2+3x-4 \end{aligned}  
For  f(x)=g(x) , we have  f(x)-g(x)=0 .
So, we have  2x^2+3x-4=0 .
Therefore, we have  x=\frac{-3\pm\sqrt{(3)^2-4(2)(-4)}}{2(2)} .
Thus, the exact values of all the roots are  \frac{-3+\sqrt{41}}{4}  and  \frac{-3-\sqrt{41}}{4} .

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText: 求6x^{2}y^{3}及4xy^{2}z的H.C.F.及L.C.M.。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn: Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of 6x^{2}y^{3} and 4xy^{2}z.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
\(6x^2 y^3 = 2 \cdot 3 \cdot x^2 \cdot y^3\)  
\(4xy^2 z = 2^2 \cdot x \cdot y^2 \cdot z\)  
H.C.F. = \(2xy^2\)  
L.C.M. = \(2^2 \cdot 3 \cdot x^2 \cdot y^3 \cdot z = 12x^2 y^3 z\)
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
\(6x^2 y^3 = 2 \cdot 3 \cdot x^2 \cdot y^3\)  
\(4xy^2 z = 2^2 \cdot x \cdot y^2 \cdot z\)  
H.C.F. = \(2xy^2\)  
L.C.M. = \(2^2 \cdot 3 \cdot x^2 \cdot y^3 \cdot z = 12x^2 y^3 z\)

senior_secondary.questionText: 某汽車以平均速率 72km/h 由 P 城駛至 Q 城，該汽車然後以平均速率 90 km/h 由 Q 城駛至 R 城。已知該汽車在整段行程中以 161 分鐘行駛 210 km 。該汽車由 P 城駛至 Q 城需時多久 ?
senior_secondary.questionTextEn: A car travels from city P to city Q at an average speed of 72 km/h, and then from city Q to city R at an average speed of 90 km/h. The car travels 210 km in 161 minutes over the entire journey. How long does it take the car to travel from city P to city Q?
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
設所需時間為 x 分鐘。

72\left(\frac{x}{60}\right)+90\left(\frac{161-x}{60}\right)=210

18x=1890

\therefore所需時間為 105 分鐘。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Let x minutes be the required time.
 72\left(\frac{x}{60}\right)+90\left(\frac{161-x}{60}\right)=210 
 18x=1890 
 \therefore The required time is 105 minutes.

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText: 在某渡輪上，女乘客人數較男乘客人數多 40\% 。 若 24 名女乘客離開該渡輪，則男乘客人數較女乘客人數多 40\% 。 求在該渡輪上男乘客人數 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn: On a ferry, the number of female passengers exceeds the number of male passengers by 40\\%. If 24 female passengers leave the ferry, the number of male passengers will then exceed the number of female passengers by 40\\%. Find the number of male passengers on the ferry.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
設 $x$ 及 $y$ 分別為在該渡輪上男乘客人數及原本的女乘客人數。
$$\begin{cases}
y=(1+40\\%)x \\
x=(1+40\\%)(y-24)
\end{cases}$$
故此，可得 $x=1.4(1.4x-24)$。
求解後，可得 $x=35$。
因此，在該渡輪上男乘客人數為 35。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Let x and y represent the number of male passengers on the ferry and the original number of female passengers, respectively.

\begin{cases}
y=(1+40\\\%)x \\
x=(1+40\\\%)(y-24)

\end{cases}
Therefore, we can obtain x=1.4(1.4x-24).
Solving this problem, we get x=35.
Therefore, the number of male passengers on the ferry is 35.

senior_secondary.questionTextEn: 7 pears and 3 oranges cost 47, while 5 pears and 6 oranges cost 49. Find the price list for one pear. (4 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
設梨的價格為 x，橘子的價格為 y。

\left\{\begin{array}{l}7x+3y=47\\5x+6y=49\end{array}\right.

因此，我們有 2(7x)-5x=2(47)-49。

解得 x=5。

所以，梨子的價格是 5 美元。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Let  x  be the price of a pear and  y  be the price of an orange.
 \left\{\begin{array}{l}7x+3y=47\\5x+6y=49\end{array}\right. 
So, we have  2(7x)-5x=2(47)-49 .
Solving, we have  x=5 .
Thus, the price of a pear is  5 .

假設當天有 x 位老年病患就診。

120x + 160(67 - x) = 9000

10720 - 40x = 9000

40x = 1720

x = 43

因此，當天有 43 位老年病患就診。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Assume that  x  elderly patients consulted the doctor on that day.
  120x + 160(67 - x) = 9000  
  
10720 - 40x = 9000  
  40x = 1720  
  
x = 43  
Thus, 43 elderly patients consulted the doctor on that day.

設購買的柳橙數量為 x。

則購買的蘋果數量為 20 - x。

現在，2x + 3(20 - x) = 46

解得：

x = 14。

因此，購買的柳橙數量為 14。

Now, 2x + 3(20 - x) = 46
Solving, we have
x = 14.
Thus, the number of oranges bought is 14.

senior_secondary.questionTextEn: A cruise ship sells only first-class and economy class tickets. A total of 600 tickets were sold, with the number of economy class tickets sold being three times the number of first-class tickets. If a first-class ticket costs 850 and a economy class ticket costs 500, calculate the total value of the tickets sold.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
設頭等艙售票數為 x。

則經濟艙售票數量為 3x。因此，我們有：

x + 3x = 600

4x = 600

x = 150

售出機票的總金額

= (150 × 850) - (3 × 50) × 500

= 352,500
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
Let  x  be the number of first-class tickets sold.
Then, the number of economy-class tickets sold is  3x . Therefore, we have
  x + 3x = 600  
  
4x = 600  
  x = 150  
The sum of money for the tickets sold
  
=(150 \times 850) - (3 \times 50) \times 500  
  =\ 352,500

senior_secondary.questionText: 圖 3 表示一個由鐵絲製成的長方體的框架。它的底面是邊長為 x cm 的正方形，高為 y cm。對角線 AB 的長度為 9 cm。用於框架的鐵絲總長度（包括對角線 AB）為 69 cm。求 x 和 y 的所有值。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Figure 3 represents the framework of a cuboid made of iron wire. It has a square base of side $x$ cm and a height of $y$ cm. The length of the diagonal $AB$ is 9 cm. The total length of wire used for the framework (including the diagonal $AB$) is 69 cm.
\text{Find all the values of x and y}
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
AC² = x² + x²
= 2x²

AB² = AC² + BC²
= 2x² + y²

2x² + y² = 92

i.e. 8x + 4y + 9 = 69
2x + y = 15

Sub. y = 15 - 2x in 2x² + y² = 9²,
2x² + (15 - 2x)² = 81
6x² - 60x + 144 = 0
x² - 10x + 24 = 0
(x - 4)(x - 6) = 0

x = 4 or 6
x = 4,}
y = 7.}

x = 6,}
y = 3.}

ALTERNATIVELY,

Sub. x = $\frac{15 - y}{2}$ in 2x² + y² = 9²,

$2\left[\frac{15 - y}{2}\right]^2 + y^2 = 9^2$

y² - 10y + 21 = 0

(y - 3)(y - 7) = 0

y = 3 or 7

y = 7,
x = 4.

y = 3,
x = 6.

  \left\{\begin{array}{l} a+10b=10600 \\ a+6b=9000 \end{array}\right.

10a)

C The circumference of the circle

senior_secondary.questionText:
一周界為 $\ell$ 米的託盤的重量為 $W$ 克。已知 $W$ 為兩部分之和，一部分隨 $\ell$ 正變，另一部分隨 $\ell^2$ 正變。當 $\ell=1$ 時，$W=181$；且當 $\ell=2$ 時，$W=402$。
(a) 求一周界為 1.2 米的託盤的重量。
(b) 若一託盤的重量為 594 克，求該託盤的周界。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
A tray with a perimeter of \ell meters weighs W grams. W is the sum of two parts, one of which changes positively with \ell, and the other with \ell^2. When \ell=1, W=181; and when \ell=2, W=402.

(a) Find the weight of the tray with a perimeter of 1.2 meters.

(b) If a tray weighs 594 grams, find the perimeter of the tray.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
11a)

設 W=h\ell+k\ell^{2}，其中 h 和 k 為非零常數。

\begin{cases}h(1)+k(1^{2})=181 \\ h(2)+k(2^{2})=402\end{cases}

解得 h=161 和 k=20。

所需重量

=161(1.2)+20(1.2^{2})

=222 克

11b)

20\ell^{2}+161\ell=594

20\ell^{2}+161\ell-594=0

(4\ell-11)(5\ell+54)=0


\ell=\frac{11}{4} \quad \text{或} \quad \ell=\frac{-54}{5} \quad \text{（已捨棄）}

因此，托盤的周長為 \frac{11}{4} 公尺。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
11a)
Let $W=h\ell+k\ell^{2}$, where $h$ and $k$ are non-zero constants.
$\begin{cases}h(1)+k(1^{2})=181 \\ h(2)+k(2^{2})=402\end{cases}$
Solving, we have $h=161$ and $k=20$.
The required weight
$=161(1.2)+20(1.2^{2})$
$=222$ grams

11b)
$$20\ell^{2}+161\ell=594$$
$$
20\ell^{2}+161\ell-594=0$$
$$(4\ell-11)(5\ell+54)=0$$
$$
\ell=\frac{11}{4} \quad \text{or} \quad \ell=\frac{-54}{5} \quad \text{(rejected)}$$
Thus, the perimeter of the tray is $\frac{11}{4}$ metres.

senior_secondary.questionText:
在某工場內，把 2 個底半徑均為   R   cm 的完全相同的實心金屬直立圓柱體熔化，並重新鑄成 27 個底半徑均為   r   cm 及高均為 10 cm 的完全相同的較小的實心直立圓柱體。已知較大的圓柱體的底面積為較小的 9 倍。

(i)   r:R  
(ii) 較大的圓柱體的高。
(b) 某工匠宣稱較小的圓柱體與較大的圓柱體相似。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"In a factory, two identical solid metal cylinders, each with a base radius of R cm, are melted down and recast into 27 identical smaller solid cylinders, each with a base radius of r cm and a height of 10 cm. The base area of ​​the larger cylinder is 9 times that of the smaller one.

(a) Find

(i) r:R

(ii) The height of the larger cylinder.

(b) A craftsman claims that the smaller cylinders are similar to the larger cylinders. Do you agree? Explain your answer."
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
"13ai)

\begin{aligned}

 \frac{\pi r^{2}}{\pi R^{2}}=\frac{1}{9} \\

 \left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^{2}=\frac{1}{9} \\

 \frac{r}{R}=\frac{1}{3} \\

 r:R=1:3

\end{aligned}

13aii)
設 h cm 為較大圓柱體的高度。

2\pi R^2h=27(\pi r^2(10))

h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^2

h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2

h=15

因此，一個圓柱體的高度為較大的圓柱體底面半徑為 15 公分。

13b)

較小圓柱體的底半徑 / 較大圓柱體的底半徑 = 1/3

較小圓柱體的高度 / 較大圓柱體的高度 = 10/15 = 2/3

較小圓柱體的底半徑 / 較大圓柱體的底半徑 ≠ 較小圓柱體的高度 / 較大圓柱體的高度
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
13ai)
\begin{aligned}
    \frac{\pi r^{2}}{\pi R^{2}}=\frac{1}{9} \\
    \left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^{2}=\frac{1}{9} \\
    \frac{r}{R}=\frac{1}{3} \\
    r:R=1:3
\end{aligned}

13aii)
Let   h   cm be the height of a larger circular cylinder.
  2\pi R^2h=27(\pi r^2(10))  
  h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^2  
  h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2  
  h=15  
Thus, the height of a larger circular cylinder is   15   cm .

13b)
  \frac{\text{The base radius of a smaller circular cylinder}}{\text{The base radius of a larger circular cylinder}} = \frac{1}{3}  

  \frac{\text{The height of a smaller circular cylinder}}{\text{The height  of a larger circular cylinder}} = \frac{10}{15} = \frac{2}{3}  

  \frac{\text{The base radius of a smaller circular cylinder}}{\text{The base radius of a larger circular cylinder}}  \neq \frac{\text{The height of a smaller circular cylinder}}{\text{The height of a larger circular cylinder}}

senior_secondary.questionText:
設 C 為一表面積是 A\mathrm{m}^2 的罐的髹漆成本。已知 C 為兩部分之和，一部分為常數，而另一部分隨 A 正變。當 A=2 時， C=62 ；當 A=6 時， C=74 。

senior_secondary.questionTextEn:

senior_secondary.questionText:
f(x)  為兩部分之和，一部分隨  x^2  正變，而另一部分隨  x  正變。假定
 f(-2)=28  及  f(6)=-36 。
(a) 求  f(x) 。
(b) 圖 2 顯示  y=3(x-6)^2+k  的圖像及  y=f(x)  的圖像，其中  k  爲一常數。該兩圖像有相同的頂點。
(i) 求 k 的值
(ii) 已知 A 及 B 均爲 y=3(x-6)^2+k 的圖像上的點，而 C 及 D 均爲 y= f ( x) 的圖像上的點。 再者 ,  ABCD 爲一長方形且 AB 平行於 x 軸 。 A 的 x 坐標爲 10 。 求長方形 ABCD 的面積 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"f(x) is the sum of two parts, one of which changes positively with x^2, and the other with x. Assume

f(-2) = 28 and f(6) = -36.

(a) Find f(x).

(b) Figure 2 shows the graphs of y = 3(x-6)^2 + k and y = f(x), where k is a constant. The two graphs share the same vertices.

(i) Find the value of k.

(ii) Given that A and B are points on the graph of y = 3(x-6)^2 + k, and C and D are points on the graph of y = f(x). Furthermore, ABCD is a rectangle and AB is parallel to the x axis. The x coordinate of A is 10. Find the area of ​​rectangle ABCD."
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
11a)

設 f(x) = ax² + bx

因為 f(-2) = 28，所以

a(-2)² + b(-2) = 28

2a - b = 14

因為 f(6) = -36，所以

a(6)² + b(6) = -36

6a + b = -6

解方程組 2a - b = 14 和 6a + b = -6，得 a = 1 且 b = -12。

因此，f(x) = x² - 12x。

11bi)

請注意，函數 y=3(x-6)²+k 的圖像的頂點是 (6,k)。

也要注意，函數 y=3(x-6)²+k 的圖像和函數 y=f(x) 的圖像具有相同的頂點。

所以，函數 y=f(x) 的圖像的頂點也是 (6,k)。

因為 f(6)=-36，所以 k=-36。

11bii)

當 x=10 時，我們有 y=3(10-6)^2-36=12。

點 A 的座標是 (10,12)。

當 y=12 時，我們有 3(x-6)^2-36=12。

所以，我們有 x=2 或 x=10。

點 B 的座標是 (2,12)。

AB = 10-2 = 8

當 x=10 時，我們有 y=10^2-12(10)=-20。

點 D 的座標是 (10,-2​​0)。



AD = 12-(-20) = 32

矩形 ABCD 的面積

= (8)(32)

= 256
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
11a)
Let f(x) = ax^2 + bx
Since f(-2) = 28, we have
a(-2)^2 + b(-2) = 28
2a - b = 14

Since f(6) = -36, we have
a(6)^2 + b(6) = -36
6a + b = -6

Solving 2a - b = 14 and 6a + b = -6, we have a = 1 and b = -12.

Thus, we have f(x) = x^2 - 12x.

11bi)
Note that the vertex of the graph of   y=3(x-6)^2+k   is   (6,k) .
Also note that the graph of   y=3(x-6)^2+k   and the graph of
 y=f(x)  have the same vertex.
So, the vertex of the graph of   y=f(x)  is also   (6,k) .
Since   f(6)=-36  , we have   k=-36  .

11bii)
When  x=10 , we have  y=3(10-6)^2-36=12 .
The coordinates of  A  are (10,12).
When  y=12 , we have  3(x-6)^2-36=12 .
So, we have  x=2  or  x=10 .
The coordinates of  B  are (2,12).
  AB = 10-2 = 8

15a)
Let  C=aA+\frac{bA^{2}}{n}  where  a  and  b  are non-zero constants.

When  A=50  and  n=500 ,  C=350 , we have

 50a+\frac{(50^{2})b}{500}=350 

 10a+b=70 

When  A=20  and  n=400 ,  C=100 , we have

 20a+\frac{(20^{2})b}{400}=100 

 20a+b=100 

Solving (1) and (2), we have

 a=3  and  b=40 .

15bi)
\mathrm{Note\(\sim\)that}\quad P=8A-\left(3A+\frac{40A^{2}}{n}\right).\mathrm{Thus,\(\sim\)we\(\sim\)have}\quad P=5A-\frac{40A^{2}}{n}.

15bii)
When  P:n=5:32 ,
  \frac{5n}{32}=5A-\frac{40A^2}{n}  
  
256A^2-32An+n^2=0  
  (16A-n)^2=0  
Thus, we have  A:n=1:16  .

15biii)
When n=500 and P=100, we have 5A-  \frac{40A^2}{500} =100.
So, we have  2A^2-125A+2500=0 .
A= \frac{-(-125)^2-4(2)(2500)}{2} 
=-4375
<0
Thus, it is impossible to make a profit of  100.

15biv)
When n = 400,
  P = 5A - \frac{40A^2}{400}  
  
= 5A - \frac{A^2}{10}  
  = \frac{-1}{10}(A^2 - 50A)  
  
= \frac{-1}{10}(A^2 - 50A + 25^2 - 25^2)

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
直線 $L_1: 2x-y+4=0$ 與 $x$ 軸及 $y$ 軸分別交於 $A$ 及 $B$ 。直線 $L_2$ 通過 $B$ 並垂直於 $L_1$ ，且與 $x$ 軸交於 $C$ 。由原點 $O$ 作一直線垂直於 $L_2$ 且與 $L_2$ 交於 $D$ 。
寫出 $A$ 及 $B$ 的坐標。
求 $L_1$ 的方程。  
求 $\triangle ODC$ 的面積與四邊形 $OABD$ 的面積之比。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Line L_1: 2x - y + 4 = 0 intersects the x axis and the y axis at A and B respectively. Line L_2 passes through B and is perpendicular to L_1, intersecting the x axis at C. A line is drawn from the origin O perpendicular to L_2 and intersecting L_2 at D.

Write down the coordinates of A and B.

Find the equation of L_1.

Find the ratio of the area of ​​\triangle ODC to the area of ​​quadrilateral OABD.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
13a)

將 y=0 代入 2x-y+4=0，得到 x=-2。

因此，A 點的座標為 (-2,0)。

將 x=0 代入 2x-y+4=0，得 y=4。

因此，B 點的座標為 (0,4)。

13b)

因為 L₁ 的斜率為 2

因為 L₂ 的斜率為 -1/2

因此，L₂ 的方程式為：

y=-x/2+4

x+2y-8=0

13c)

將 y=0 代入 x+2y-8=0，得 x=8。

因此，B 點的座標為 (0,4)。 C 點位於 (8, 0) 處。

因此，我們有 OC:AC=4:5。

求比例為：

=4²:(5²-4²)

=16:9
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
13a)
Putting $y=0$ in $2x-y+4=0$, we have $x=-2$.
Thus, the coordinates of $A$ are $(-2,0)$.
Putting $x=0$ in $2x-y+4=0$, we have $y=4$.
Thus, the coordinates of $B$ are $(0,4)$.

13b)
$\because$ the slope of $L_{1}$ is 2
$\because$ the slope of $L_{2}$ is $-\frac{1}{2}$
Thus, the equation of $L_{2}$ is
$y=-\frac{x}{2}+4$
$x+2y-8=0$

13c)
Putting $y=0$ in $x+2y-8=0$, we have $x=8$.
So, the coordinates of $C$ are $(8, 0)$.
Therefore, we have $OC:AC=4:5$.
The required ratio
$=4^{2}:(5^{2}-4^{2})$
$=16:9$

senior_secondary.questionText:
已知  y  為兩部分之和：一部分隨  x  正比，另一部分則隨  x  的平方正比。當  x=3  時， y=3 ；且當  x=4  時， y=12 。

senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Given that y is the sum of two parts: one part is proportional to x, and the other part is proportional to the square of x. When x = 3, y = 3; and when x = 4, y = 12.

(a) Express y in terms of x. (4 points)

(b) If x is an integer and y < 42, find all possible values ​​of x. (4 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
10a)

設 y=ax^{2}+bx，其中 a 和 b 為非零常數。

當 x=3 時，y=3，因此我們有：

9a+3b=3

3a+b=1 … … … … (1)

當 x=4 時，y=12，因此我們有：

16a+4b=12

4a+b=3 … … … … (2)

聯立方程式 (1) 和 (2)，可得：

\left\{\begin{array}{l}a=2 \\ b=-5\end{array}\right.

\therefore \quad y=2x^{2}-5x

10b)

當 y < 42 時，有：

2x^2 - 5x < 42 \quad \text{(by (a))}

因此，我們有


2x^2 - 5x - 42 < 0

(2x + 7)(x - 6) < 0



-\frac{7}{2} < x < 6

由於 x 是整數，我們有
x = -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 \text{ 或 } 5.

因此，x 的所有可能值為



-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 \text{ 與 } 5."
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
10a)
Let   y=ax^{2}+bx  , where  a  and  b  are non-zero constants.
When  x=3 ,  y=3 , so we have
 9a+3b=3 
 3a+b=1    \dots\dots\dots\dots  (1)
When  x=4 ,  y=12 , so we have
 16a+4b=12 
 4a+b=3    \dots\dots\dots\dots  (2)
Solving (1) and (2), we have
 \left\{\begin{array}{l}a=2 \\ b=-5\end{array}\right. 
 \therefore \quad y=2x^{2}-5x 

10b)
When y < 42, we have
  2x^2 - 5x < 42 \quad \text{(by (a))}  
Therefore, we have
  
2x^2 - 5x - 42 < 0  
  (2x + 7)(x - 6) < 0  
  
-\frac{7}{2} < x < 6  
Since x is an integer, we have
  x = -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 \text{ or } 5.  
Thus, all the possible values of x are
  
-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 \text{ and } 5.

senior_secondary.questionText:
某太陽能玩具車的速率為 V cm/s ，而其太陽能面板的長為 L cm ，其中 5 ≤ L ≤ 25 。V 為 L 的函數。已知 V 為兩部分之和，一部分隨 L 正變，另一部分則隨 L 的平方正變。當 L = 10 時， V = 30 ；且當 L = 15 時， V = 75 。  
(a) 以 L 表 V 。  
(b) 當 V ≥ 30 時，求 L 的取值範圍。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"A solar-powered toy car has a speed of V cm/s and a solar panel length of L cm, where 5 ≤ L ≤ 25. V is a function of L. It is known that V is the sum of two parts, one of which changes positively with L, and the other changes positively with the square of L. When L = 10, V = 30; and when L = 15, V = 75.

(a) Express V in terms of L.

(b) When V ≥ 30, find the range of values ​​for L."
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
10a)

設 V = aL^2 + bL，其中 a 和 b 為常數。

當 L = 10 時，V = 30，因此我們有：

100a + 10b = 30

10a + b = 3

因此 (1)

當 L = 15 時，V = 75，因此我們有：

225a + 15b = 75

15a + b = 5

因此 (2)

解 (1) 和 (2)，我們得到：

\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a = \frac{2}{5} \\ b = -1 \end{array} \right.

因此 V = \frac{2}{5}L^2 - L

10b)

當 V由於 \geq 30，我們有 \frac{2}{5}L^2 - L \geq 30（由 (a) 可知）。因此，我們有：

2L^2 - 5L - 150 \geq 0



(2L + 15)(L - 10) \geq 0

L \geq 10 或 L \leq -\frac{15}{2}

由於 5 \leq L \leq 25，我們有：

10 \leq L \leq 25"
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
10a)
Let  V = aL^2 + bL , where  a  and  b  are constants.

When  L = 10 ,  V = 30 , so we have
 100a + 10b = 30 
 10a + b = 3 
 \therefore (1) 

When  L = 15 ,  V = 75 , so we have
 225a + 15b = 75 
 15a + b = 5 
 \therefore (2) 

Solving (1) and (2), we have
 \left\{ \begin{array}{l} a = \frac{2}{5} \\ b = -1 \end{array} \right. 
 \therefore V = \frac{2}{5}L^2 - L 

10b)
When  V \geq 30 , we have  \frac{2}{5}L^2 - L \geq 30  (by (a)). Therefore, we have
  2L^2 - 5L - 150 \geq 0  
  
(2L + 15)(L - 10) \geq 0  
 L \geq 10  or  L \leq -\frac{15}{2} 
Since  5 \leq L \leq 25 , we have
  10 \leq L \leq 25

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
一張書寶的面積為 $A cm^2$ 而其周界為 $P cm$。$A$ 為 $P$ 的函數。已知 $A$ 為兩部分之和，一部分隨 $P$ 正變，另一部分則隨 $P$ 的平方正變。當 $P=24$ 時，$A=36$；且當 $P=18$ 時，$A=9$。

(a) 以 $P$ 表 $A$ 。 (3分)

(b)
(i) 最佳銷量紙書寶的面積為 54 $cm^2$。求該書寶的周界。
(ii) 製造商想製造一袖珍金書寶，其形狀與最佳銷量紙書寶相似。若該袖珍金書寶的面積為 8 $cm^2$，求其周界。 (5分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
A book has an area of ​​A cm^2 and a perimeter of P cm. A is a function of P. A is the sum of two parts, one of which changes positively with P, and the other changes positively with the square of P. When P=24, A=36; and when P=18, A=9.

(a) Express A in terms of P. (3 points)

(b)

(i) The area of ​​the best-selling paper book is 54 cm^2. Find the perimeter of this book.

(ii) A manufacturer wants to create a miniature golden book, similar in shape to the best-selling paper book. If the area of ​​this miniature golden book is 8 cm^2, find its perimeter. (5 points)
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
11a)

設 A=ap+b^{2}，其中 a 和 b 為常數。

代入 P=24，A=36，

24a+576b=36

2a+48b=3 ............(1)

代入 P=18，A=9，

18a+324b=9

2a+36b=1 ............(2)

解 (1) 和 (2)

a=-\frac{5}{2}

b=\frac{1}{6}

\therefore A=-\frac{5}{2}P+\frac{1}{6}P^{2}

11bi)

當 A = 54 時，

-\frac{5}{2}P + \frac{1}{6}P^2 = 54


P^2 - 15P - 324 = 0

P = 27 \quad \text{或} \quad P = -12 \quad (\text{捨棄})



\therefore \quad \text{所需的周長為} 27 \text{ 釐米}

11bii)

設 P' \text{ 釐米} 為金書籤的周長。

\left(\frac{P'}{27}\right)^2 = \frac{8}{54}


P' = 6\sqrt{3} \approx 10.4

金書籤的周長為 6\sqrt{3} \approx 10.4 公分。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
11a)
Let $A=ap+b^{2}$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants.
Sub. $P=24$, $A=36$,
$24a+576b=36$
$2a+48b=3$  $............(1)$
Sub. $P=18$, $A=9$,
$18a+324b=9$
$2a+36b=1$  $............(2)$
Solving (1) and (2)
$a=-\frac{5}{2}$
$b=\frac{1}{6}$
$\therefore A=-\frac{5}{2}P+\frac{1}{6}P^{2}$

11bi)
When $A = 54$,
$$-\frac{5}{2}P + \frac{1}{6}P^2 = 54$$
$$
P^2 - 15P - 324 = 0$$
$$P = 27 \quad \text{or} \quad P = -12 \quad (\text{rejected})$$
$$
\therefore \quad \text{the required perimeter is } 27 \text{ cm}$$

11bii)
Let $P' \text{ cm}$ be the perimeter of the gold bookmark.
$$\left(\frac{P'}{27}\right)^2 = \frac{8}{54}$$
$$
P' = 6\sqrt{3} \approx 10.4$$
The perimeter of the gold bookmark is $6\sqrt{3} \approx 10.4$ cm.

(b) Assume Wenjun repays 1800 per month (the final repayment may be less than 1800).

(i)" (i) How many months would it take Wenjun to fully repay the loan?

(ii) Wenjun wants to repay the loan with a lower monthly payment. He requests a monthly payment of 900, but the bank refuses. Why?

senior_secondary.questionText:
考慮某國的糧食產量及人口問題。該國在第一年裏，糧食的年產量爲8百萬公頃，第一年年末時的人口爲2百萬。設糧食的年產量每年增加1百萬公頃，人口則每年增加6\%。
(a) 求該國在
(i) 第三年裏、
(ii) 第n年裏
的糧食年產量（答案以百萬公頃計）。
(b)求首25年內糧食的總產量(答案以百萬公噸計)。
(c) 求該國在  
(i) 第三年年終時、  
(ii) 第n年年終時  
的人口。  
(d) 從第一年年終起計，問最少在該年內人口會增加一倍？
(e) 若「糧食人均年產量」（即$\frac{\text{某年的糧食年產量}}{\text{當年終時的人口}}$）小於0.2公頃，則該國會面臨糧食短缺。試估計在第100年的年終時該國是否面臨糧食短缺。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Consider the food production and population of a certain country. In the first year, the country's annual food production is 8 million hectares, and the population at the end of the first year is 2 million. Assume that the annual food production increases by 1 million hectares each year, and the population increases by 6\\% each year.

(a) Find the country's annual food production in

(i) the third year,

(ii) the nth year (the answer is in millions of hectares).

(b) Find the total food production in the first 25 years (the answer is in millions of metric tons).

(c) Find the country's population at

(i) the end of the third year,

(ii) the end of the nth year.

(d) Starting from the end of the first year, what is the minimum population doubling expected within that year?

(e) If the "annual grain yield per capita" (i.e., \frac{\text{annual grain yield in a given year}}{\text{population at the end of that year}}) is less than 0.2 hectares, the country will face a food shortage. Estimate whether the country will face a food shortage at the end of the 100th year.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
(a) (i) 10百萬公頃  
(ii) (n + 7)百萬公頃  

(b) 500百萬公頃  

(c) (i) 2.382032百萬  
(ii) 2(1.06)^n百萬  

(d) 12  

(e) 是
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn: "(a) (i) 10 million hectares (ii) (n + 7) million hectares (b) 500 million hectares (c) (i) 2.382032 million (ii) 2(1.06)^n million (d) 12 (e) is"

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
設 f ( x) = 2x^2-4kx+ 3k^{2}+ 5  其中 k  為一實常數。

(a)  y= f ( x)  的圖像是否與 x  軸相交？試解釋你的答案。
(2分) (3 分)
(b) 利用配方法，以 k 表 y= f (x) 的圖像的頂點的坐標 。
(c) 在同一直角坐標系中，設 S 及 T 分別為 y= f ( x) 的圖像及 y= 2- f ( x) 的圖像
上的動點 。 將原點記為 O  。 某人宣稱當 S 與 T 最接近時， \Delta OST 的外心
在 x  軸上。該宣稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
(4分)
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
"Let f(x) = 2x^2 - 4kx + 3k^{2} + 5, where k is a real constant.

(a) Does the graph of y = f(x) intersect the x-axis? Explain your answer.

(2 points) (3 points)

(b) Using the completing the square method, let k represent the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of y = f(x).

(c) In the same rectangular coordinate system, let S and T be moving points on the graphs of y = f(x) and y = 2 - f(x), respectively. Let the origin be O. Someone claims that when S and T are closest, the circumcenter of ∠Delta OST lies on the x-axis. Is this claim correct? Explain your answer.

(4 points)"
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
  ( - 4 k ) ^ { 2 } - 4 ( 2 ) ( 3 k ^ { 2 } + 5 )  
  
= - 8 ( k ^ { 2 } + 5 )  
Since  - 8 ( k ^ { 2 } + 5 ) < 0  for all real  k , the equation f(x) = 0 does not have real roots and the graph of y = f(x) does not cut the x-axis.

18b)
  2x^2-4kx+3k^2+5  
  
=2(x^2-2kx+k^2)+k^2+5  
  =2(x-k)^2+k^2+5.  

18c)
Note that when S and T are nearest to each other, they coincide with the vertices of the graphs of y=f(x) and y=2-f(x) respectively.
The coordinates of S is (k, k^2+5) and that of T is (k, -k^2-3).
Thus, the y-coordinate of the midpoint of ST is 1.
The perpendicular bisector of ST is y-1=0.
The claim is disagreed.
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
18a)

( - 4 k ) ^ { 2 } - 4 ( 2 ) ( 3 k ^ { 2 } + 5 )



= - 8 ( k ^ { 2 } + 5 )

由於對所有實數 k，- 8 ( k ^ { 2 } + 5 ) < 0，方程式 f(x) = 0 沒有實根，因此 y = f(x) 的圖像不與 x 軸相交。

18b)

2x^2-4kx+3k^2+5



=2(x^2-2kx+k^2)+k^2+5

=2(x-k)^2+k^2+5.

18c)

請注意，當 S 和 T 彼此最接近時，它們與函數影像的頂點重合。 y=f(x) 和 y=2-f(x)。

點 S 的座標為 (k, k²+5)，點 T 的座標為 (k, -k²-3)。

因此，ST 的中點的 y 座標為 1。

ST 的垂直平分線為 y-1=0。

該結論不成立。

=    \frac{-1}{3} \left(x-18\right)^{2}-13
\end{aligned}

senior_secondary.questionText:
點 P 及點 Q 的坐標分別為 (-3, 5) 及 (2, -7)。P 線原點 O 逆時針方向旋轉 270° 至 P'。Q 向左平移 21 單位至 Q'。

(a) 寫出 P' 及 Q' 的坐標。
(b) 證明 PQ 垂直於 P'Q'。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The coordinates of points P and Q are (-3, 5) and (2, -7) respectively. The origin O of line P is rotated 270° counterclockwise to P'. Point Q is translated 21 units to the left to Q'.

(a) Write down the coordinates of P' and Q'.

(b) Prove that PQ is perpendicular to P'Q'.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
The coordinates of $P'$ are (5, 3).
The coordinates of $Q'$ are (-19, -7).

b)
The slope of $PQ$
=$\frac{5+7}{-3-2}$
=$\frac{-12}{5}$

The slope of $P'Q'$
=$\frac{3+7}{5+19}$
=$\frac{5}{12}$

So, the product of the slope of $PQ$ and the slope of $P'Q'$ is -1.
Thus, $PQ$ is perpendicular to $P'Q'$.
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
8a)

點 P' 的座標為 (5, 3)。

點 Q' 的座標為 (-19, -7)。

b)

直線 PQ 的斜率

= 5 + 7 / (-3 - 2)

= -12 / 5

直線 P'Q' 的斜率

= 3 + 7 / (5 + 19)

= 5 / 12

因此，直線 PQ 的斜率與直線 P'Q' 的斜率的乘積為 -1。

所以，直線 PQ 是垂直於直線 P'Q'。

senior_secondary.questionText:
點 A 及點 B 的坐標分別為 (-3,4) 及 (9,-9) 。A 緣原點逆時針方向旋轉 90° 至 A' 。B' 為 B 對 x 軸的反射影像。
(a) 寫出 A' 及 B' 的坐標。
(b) 證明 AB 垂直於 A'B' 。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The coordinates of points A and B are (-3, 4) and (9, -9), respectively. Point A is rotated 90° counterclockwise from the origin to A'. B' is the reflection of B across the x-axis.

(a) Write down the coordinates of A' and B'.

(b) Prove that AB is perpendicular to A'B'.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
\text{The coordinates of }A=(-4,-3)\text{The coordinates of }B=(9,9)

b)
$$\text{Slope of AB}$$
$$
=\frac{-9-4}{9-(-3)}$$
$$=\frac{-13}{12}$$
$$
\text{Slope of A'B'}$$
$$=\frac{-3-9}{-4-9}$$
$$
=\frac{12}{13}$$
$$\text{Slope of AB} \times \text{Slope of A'B'}$$
$$
=\frac{-13}{12} \times \frac{12}{13}$$
$$=-1$$
$$
\therefore AB \perp A'B'$$

senior_secondary.questionText:
點 P 及點 Q 的坐標分別為 (50,0) 及 (32,t),其中 t>0  。將原點記為 O  。設 R 
為一點使得 OQ 為 \Delta OPR 的中線 。假定 G 及 H 分別為 \Delta OPR 的外心及垂心 。
(a) 以 t 表 G 及 H 的坐標 。
(b) 設 S 為 OP 上的一點使得 QS 垂直於 OP  。已知 \angle PQS=\angle POQ  。
( i)  藉考慮  \tan \angle PQS ,證明  t= 24 
(ii)  O  · G 與 Q 是否共線？試解釋你的答案。
(iii) 將 \Delta OPR 的內心記為 I 。求 \Delta GHR 的面積與 \Delta IPQ 的面積之比。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The coordinates of points P and Q are (50, 0) and (32, t) respectively, where t > 0. Let the origin be O. Let R be a point such that OQ is the median of ∠Delta OPR. Assume G and H are the circumcenter and orthocenter of ∠Delta OPR respectively.

(a) Express the coordinates of G and H in terms of t.

(b) Let S be a point on OP such that QS is perpendicular to OP. Given that ∠PQS = ∠POQ.

(i) By considering tan ∠PQS, prove that t = 24.

(ii) Are O·G and Q collinear? Explain your answer.

(iii) Let I be the incenter of ∠Delta OPR. Find ∠Delta OPR. The ratio of the area of ​​GHR to the area of ​​ΔIPQ.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
19a)
 PQ  的斜率
  = \frac{t-0}{32-50}  
  
= \frac{-t}{18}  
留意  G  的  x  座標為 25。
 PR  的垂直平分線的方程為
  y-t=\frac{18}{t}(x-32)  
把  x=25  代入  y-t=\frac{18}{t}(x-32) ，可得  y=\frac{t^2-126}{t} 。
所以， G  的座標為  \left(25, \frac{t^2-126}{t}\right) 。
再者留意  R  的  x  座標為 14。
通過  O  且垂直於  PR  的直線的方程為  y=\frac{18}{t}x 。
把  x=14  代入  y=\frac{18}{t}x ，可得  y=\frac{252}{t} 。
因此， H  的座標為  \left(14, \frac{252}{t}\right) 。

19bi)
由於  ∠PQS=∠POQ  ，可得  \tan∠PQS=\tan∠POQ  。
 \frac{50-32}{t}=\frac{t}{32} 
 \frac{18}{t}=\frac{t}{32} 
 t^2-576=0 
由於  t>0  ，可得  t=24  。

19bii)
藉(a)， G  的坐標為 \left(25,\frac{75}{4}\right) 。
 Q  的坐標為(32,24)。

 OG  的斜率
 =\frac{\frac{75}{4}-0}{25-0} 
 =\frac{3}{4} 

 OQ  的斜率
 =\frac{24-0}{32-0} 
 =\frac{3}{4} 

所以， OG  的斜率與 OQ  的斜率相等。
因此， O 、 G  與 Q  共線。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
19a) The slope of PQ is:
= \frac{t-0}{32-50}
= \frac{-t}{18}
Note that the x-coordinate of G is 25.
The equation of the perpendicular bisector of PR is:
y-t=\frac{18}{t}(x-32)
Substituting x=25 into y-t=\frac{18}{t}(x-32), we get y=\frac{t^2-126}{t}.
Therefore, the coordinates of G are \left(25, \frac{t^2-126}{t}\right).
Furthermore, note that the x-coordinate of R is 14.
The equation of the line passing through O and perpendicular to PR is: y = \frac{18}{t}x.

Substituting x = 14 into y = \frac{18}{t}x, we get y = \frac{252}{t}.

Therefore, the coordinates of H are \left(14, \frac{252}{t}\right).

19bi)
Since ∠PQS = ∠POQ, we get \tan∠PQS = \tan∠POQ.

\frac{50-32}{t} = \frac{t}{32}

\frac{18}{t} = \frac{t}{32}

t^2 - 576 = 0

Since t > 0, we get t = 24.

19bii)
Borrowing (a), G The coordinates of O are \left(25,\frac{75}{4}\right).

The coordinates of Q are (32,24).

The slope of OG is:
=\frac{75}{4}-0}{25-0}
=\frac{3}{4}

The slope of OQ is:
=\frac{24-0}{32-0}
=\frac{3}{4}

Therefore, the slope of OG is equal to the slope of OQ.

Therefore, O, G, and Q are collinear.

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
點 A 的坐標為 (-4,6) 。A 緣原點 O 逆時針方向旋轉 90° 至 B 。M 為 AB 的中點。
(a) 求 M 的坐標。
(b) OM 是否垂直於 AB？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
Point A has coordinates (-4, 6). A is rotated 90° counterclockwise from the origin O to point B. M is the midpoint of AB.

(a) Find the coordinates of M.

(b) Is OM perpendicular to AB? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
8a)

B點的座標為(-6,-4)。

M點的座標為：

=(-4+(-6)/2, 6+(-4)/2)

=(-5,1)

8b)

直線OM的斜率

=(1-0)/(-5-0)

=(-1)/(5)

直線AB的斜率

=(6-(-4))/(-4-(-6))

=5

由於直線OM的斜率與直線AB的斜率的乘積為-1，因此直線OM垂直於直線AB。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
8a)
The coordinates of B are (-6,-4).
The coordinates of M
=$\left(\frac{-4+(-6)}{2}, \frac{6+(-4)}{2}\right)$
=(-5,1)

8b)
The slope of $OM$
$$=\frac{1-0}{-5-0}
=\frac{-1}{5}$$
The slope of $AB$
$$=\frac{6-(-4)}{-4-(-6)}
=5$$
Since the product of the slope of $OM$ and the slope of $AB$ is $-1$, $OM$ is perpendicular to $AB$.

senior_secondary.questionText:
點A及點B的坐標分別為(-1,-2)及(5,2)。A垂直上移6單位至A'。B'為B對y軸的反射影像。(a) 寫出 $A'$ 及 $B'$ 的坐標。
(b) $AB$ 是否平行於 $A'B'$ ? 試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The coordinates of points A and B are (-1, -2) and (5, 2) respectively. A is vertically moved 6 units upwards to A'. B' is the reflection of B across the y-axis. (a) Write down the coordinates of A' and B'.

(b) Is AB parallel to A'B'? Explain your answer."
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
9a)

點 A' 的座標為 (-1, 4)。

點 B' 的座標為 (-5, 2)。

9b)

直線 AB 的斜率

= (2 - 2) / (5 - 1)

= (2) / (3)

直線 A'B' 的斜率

= (4 - 2) / (-1 - 5)

= (1) / (2)

由於直線 AB 和直線 A'B' 的斜率不同，因此直線 AB 不平行於直線 A'B'。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
9a)
The coordinates of $A'$ are $(-1, 4)$.
The coordinates of $B'$ are $(-5, 2)$.

9b)
The slope of $AB$

$=\frac{2-(-2)}{5-(-1)}$

$=\frac{2}{3}$

The slope of $A'B'$

$=\frac{4-2}{-1-(-5)}$

$=\frac{1}{2}$

Since the slope of $AB$ and the slope of $A'B'$ are different, $AB$ is not parallel to $A'B'$.

senior_secondary.subject: Math
senior_secondary.questionText:
點 A 及點 B 的坐標分別為 (5,7)及 (13,1)。設 P 為直角坐標平面上的一動點使得 P 與 A 及 B 等距。將 P 的軌跡記為 \Gamma  。
(a) 求 \Gamma 的方程 。
(b)  \Gamma  與 x 軸及 y 軸分別相交於  H  及  K  。將原點記為  O  。 設  C  為通過  O  、 H 及 K 的圓。某人宣稱 C 的圓周超過 30 。該宣稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
The coordinates of points A and B are (5,7) and (13,1) respectively. Let P be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that P is equidistant from both A and B. Let the locus of P be denoted as '\Gamma'.

(a) Find the equation of '\Gamma'.

(b) '\Gamma' intersects the x-axis and y-axis at points H and K respectively. Let the origin be O. Let C be a circle passing through O, H, and K. Someone claims that the circumference of circle C exceeds 30. Is this claim correct? Explain your answer.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
a)
設 (x,y) 為 P 的坐標

  \begin{aligned}  \sqrt{\left(x-5\right)^{2}+\left(y-7\right)^{2}}=\sqrt{\left(x-13\right)^{2}+\left(y-1\right)^{2}}\\  4x-3y-24=0\\  \text{因此,}\Gamma\text{ 的方程為}\quad4x-3y-24=0\quad\circ\end{aligned}  

b)
把 y=0 代入 4x-3y-24=0 ，可得 x=6 。
故此， H 的坐標為 (6,0) 。
把 x=0 代入 4x-3y-24=0 ，可得 y=-8 。
所以， K 的坐標為 (0,-8) 。

C 的直徑
=HK
= \sqrt{(6-0)^{2}+(0-(-8))^{2}} 
=10

C 的圓周
=10π
≈31.41592654
\>30

因此，該宣稱正確。
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
10a) Let (x,y) be the coordinates of P.

\begin{aligned}\sqrt{\left(x-5\right)^{2}+\left(y-7\right)^{2}}=\sqrt{\left(x-13\right)^{2}+\left(y-1\right)^{2}}\\4x-3y-24=0\\\text{Therefore, the equation of }\Gamma\text{ is }\quad4x-3y-24=0\quad\circ\end{aligned}

10b) Substituting y=0 into 4x-3y-24=0, we get x=6.
Therefore, the coordinates of H are (6,0).
Substituting x=0 into 4x-3y-24=0, we get y=-8.
Therefore, the coordinates of K are (0, -8).

The diameter of C is HK = \sqrt{(6-0)^{2}+(0-(-8))^{2}} = 10

The circumference of C is 10π ≈ 31.41592654 > 30

Therefore, the claim is correct.

(b) 點 H 及點 K 的坐標分別為 (9,12)及(14,0)。設 P 為直角坐標平面上的一動點使得由 P 至 OH 的垂直距離等於由 P 至 HK 的垂直距離·其中 O 為原點。將  P  的軌跡記為 \Gamma 。
(i) 描跡 \Gamma 與 \angle OHK 之間的幾何關係。
(ii) 利用(a),求 \Gamma 的方程。
senior_secondary.questionTextEn:
(a) Let \alpha and p be the area and perimeter of \Delta CDE, respectively. Let r be the radius of the incircle of \Delta CDE. Prove that pr = 2a.

(b) Let the coordinates of points H and K be (9,12) and (14,0) respectively. Let P be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from P to OH is equal to the perpendicular distance from P to HK, where O is the origin. Let \Gamma be the locus of P.

(i) Plot the geometric relationship between \Gamma and \angle OHK.

(ii) Using (a), find the equation of \Gamma.
senior_secondary.standardAnswer:
17a)
\begin{aligned}
    \frac{r(CD)}{2}+\frac{r(DE)}{2}+\frac{r(CE)}{2}=a \\
    r(CD+DE+CE)=2a \\
    pr=2a
\end{aligned}

17bi)
\text{廠 為 OHK 的角平分線 。}

17bii)
  \frac{OH}{HK} = \sqrt{9^2 + 12^2} = 15  
  
\frac{HK}{HK} = \sqrt{(9-14)^2 + 12^2} = 13  
留意  \triangle OHK  的面積  = \frac{14 \times 12}{2} = 84 。
再者留意  \triangle OHK  的周界  = 13 + 14 + 15 = 42 。設  r  為  \triangle OHK  的內切圓的半徑。
藉 (a)，可得  42r = 2 \times 84 。
故此，可得  r = 4 。
設  (h, 4)  為  \triangle OHK  的內心的坐標。
由此，可得  (15 - h) + (14 - h) = 13 。
所以，可得  h = 8 。
 \Gamma  的斜率
  \frac{12 - 4}{9 - 8} = 8  
 \Gamma  的方程為
  
y - 4 = 8(x - 8)  
  8x - y - 60 = 0
senior_secondary.standardAnswerEn:
"17a)

\begin{aligned}

 \frac{r(CD)}{2}+\frac{r(DE)}{2}+\frac{r(CE)}{2}=a \\

 r(CD+DE+CE)=2a \\

 pr=2a

\end{aligned}

17bi)

\text{廠 is the angle bisector of OHK.}

17bii)

\frac{OH}{HK} = \sqrt{9^2 + 12^2} = 15


\frac{HK}{HK} = \sqrt{(9-14)^2 + 12^2} = 13
Note that the area of ​​\triangle OHK is = \frac{14 \times 12}{2} = 84.
Further note the perimeter of \triangle OHK is = 13 + 14 + 15 = 42. Let r be the radius of the incircle of \triangle OHK.

Borrowing from (a), we get 42r = 2 \times 84.

Therefore, we get r = 4.

Let (h, 4) be the coordinates of the incenter of \triangle OHK.

From this, we get (15 - h) + (14 - h) = 13.

So, we get h = 8.

The slope of \Gamma is:
\frac{12 - 4}{9 - 8} = 8

The equation of \Gamma is:
y - 4 = 8(x - 8)
8x - y - 60 = 0"
